points.title: Noun は～
points.formation: Noun + は
points.shortExplanation: Used to mark the topic of a sentence; 'as for', 'speaking of'.

points.title: ～の
points.formation: Noun1 + の + Noun2, (Adjective/Clause) + の (nominalized), etc.
points.shortExplanation: Express possession, apposition, or description using 'of' or ''s'.

points.title: A は B が〜
points.formation: A は (Topic) + B が (Characteristic/Feature) + Description/Action
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that there is something unique or different about A and describes what is special about it.

points.title: ～あります
points.formation: Object + が + あります
points.shortExplanation: Indicate possession or existence of inanimate objects; 'there is', 'there are'.

points.title: ～（場所）に～があります
points.formation: Place + に + Object/Thing + が + あります
points.shortExplanation: Express the existence or presence of something in a place.

points.title: Noun に～
points.formation: Noun + に
points.shortExplanation: Express a specific direction, target or purpose; 'to', 'toward', 'for'.

points.title: Nounで～
points.formation: Noun + で
points.shortExplanation: Indicate a place or means for an action or situation; 'at, in, on', 'using', or 'by means of'.

points.title: Noun を〜
points.formation: Noun + を + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the direct object of a verb.

points.title: Noun に 行きます
points.formation: Noun + に + 行きます
points.shortExplanation: Used to express going to a location.

points.title: Noun に 来ます
points.formation: Noun + に + 来ます (kimasu)
points.shortExplanation: Used to express coming to a place.

points.title: Noun に 帰ります
points.formation: Noun + に + 帰ります
points.shortExplanation: Express going back or returning to a place: 'to return to', 'to go back to'.

points.title: Noun に 戻ります
points.formation: Noun + に + 戻ります
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the action of returning to a previous state, place, or condition.

points.title: Verb に 来ます
points.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + に + 来ます
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the purpose of coming to a place; 'come to (do something)'.

points.title: Verb に 行きます
points.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + に + 行きます
points.shortExplanation: To go (somewhere) in order to do an action.

points.title: だれ～
points.formation: だれ + appropriate particle (が, は or を)
points.shortExplanation: Asking 'who' in a sentence, used to inquire about someone's identity or to clarify who is being referred to.

points.title: なに～
points.formation: Verb + なに, い-Adjective + なに, な-Adjective + なに, Noun + なに
points.shortExplanation: Asking about 'what' or 'which' in Japanese

points.title: なん～
points.formation: なん + Counter / なん + Verb / なん + Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Used to form interrogative questions and emphasize the question word for 'what', 'how'.

points.title: どこ～
points.formation: どこ + question particle
points.shortExplanation: Express 'where', used with question words for asking about locations.

points.title: どちら～
points.formation: どちら + が/を + verb, どちら + が/を + adjective, どちら + が/を + noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to ask about two choices or options.

points.title: どなた～
points.formation: どなた
points.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask 'who', used for asking about someone's identity or when seeking information about an unknown person.

points.title: どの Noun
points.formation: どの + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'which'; used to ask about specific items within a group.

points.title: どんな Noun
points.formation: どんな + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to ask or describe 'what kind' or 'what type' of something.

points.title: いくつ～
points.formation: いくつ + Noun (optional)
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'how many' or ask for the number of something.

points.title: どうやって～
points.formation: どうやって + Verb-casual
points.shortExplanation: Ask 'how' something is done or how to do something.

points.title: なんで～
points.formation: なんで + [phrase or sentence]
points.shortExplanation: Asking the reason or cause; 'why', 'how come'.

points.title: ～どう しますか。
points.formation: Situation + どうしますか
points.shortExplanation: Asking for someone's opinion or decision; 'what will you do?', 'how will you handle it?'.

points.title: ～どうですか。
points.formation: Noun + は/が + どうですか / Verb-casual + の + どうですか / い-Adjective + どうですか / な-Adjective + な + どうですか
points.shortExplanation: Asking for opinions or suggestions; 'how about', 'what do you think of'.

points.title: ～どう 言いますか。
points.formation: Word/Phrase + は [language]でどう言いますか / Word/Phrase + をどう言いますか
points.shortExplanation: Asking for the way to say something; 'how do you say'.

points.title: ～なんと 言いますか。
points.formation: Noun + は/が + なんと言いますか
points.shortExplanation: Asking how something is called or referred to; 'how do you say'

points.title: だれか〜
points.formation: だれか + Verb, だれか + Adjective, だれか + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'someone' or something done or possessed by 'someone'.

points.title: どこか～
points.formation: どこか + (Particle, if needed) + Verb/Noun/Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'somewhere', used when the specific location is unknown or uncertain.

points.title: なにか～
points.formation: なにか + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'something' or 'some kind of'.

points.title: いつか～
points.formation: いつか + sentence
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an unspecified point in time; 'someday', 'one day', 'at some point'.

points.title: だれでも～
points.formation: だれでも + Verb/Adjective/Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'anyone' or 'everyone'; 'no matter who'.

points.title: どこでも～
points.formation: Simply use the word どこでも in the sentence as an adverb to indicate 'anywhere' or 'everywhere'.
points.shortExplanation: Express 'anywhere' or 'everywhere' in Japanese.

points.title: なんでも～
points.formation: なんでも + Verb / なんでも + Adjective / なんでも + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Means 'any', 'anything', 'anyone'.

points.title: どれでも～
points.formation: どれ + でも
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'any' or 'whichever' when referring to multiple items.

points.title: いつでも～
points.formation: いつでも + (Verb)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'anytime', 'always', or 'whenever'.
points.usageNote: "Anytime/always" - emphasizes availability at any moment.

points.title: だれも～ません
points.formation: だれも + Verb-negative (ません)
points.shortExplanation: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in negative sentences.

points.title: なにも～ません
points.formation: なにも + Verb-ます form + ません
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'not anything', 'nothing'.

points.title: どこにも + Verb + ません
points.formation: どこにも + Verb-negative
points.shortExplanation: Express 'not anywhere' or 'nowhere' with a negative verb.
points.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere".

points.title: い-Adjective: Negative Polite Form
points.formation: い-Adjective (remove い, add く) + ないです / ありません
points.shortExplanation: Change an い-adjective into a polite negative form with ～くないです (or ～くありません).

points.title: い-Adjective く + Verb
points.formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + く + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Used to connect an い-adjective to a verb, modifying the verb (adverbial usage).

points.title: い-Adjective て
points.formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + くて + い-Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Used to connect two or more い-adjectives to describe something.

points.title: な-Adjective に + Verb
points.formation: な-Adjective (remove な) + に + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Turn a な-adjective into an adverb by adding に.

points.title: な-Adjective で～
points.formation: な-Adjective + で
points.shortExplanation: Usage of で to connect or add information with a な-adjective.

points.title: い-Adjective く します
points.formation: い-Adjective (remove い, add く) + します
points.shortExplanation: Use an い-adjective to express 'to make' or 'to become'.

points.title: な-Adjective に します
points.formation: な-Adjective + に + します
points.shortExplanation: Expressing a decision or preference with a な-adjective.

points.title: な-Adjective に なります
points.formation: な-Adjective (remove な) + に + なります
points.shortExplanation: Express a change or transformation into a state described by the な-adjective.

points.title: Noun に します
points.formation: Noun + に します
points.shortExplanation: Express a choice or decision; 'choose', 'decide on'.

points.title: Noun に なります
points.formation: Noun + に + なります
points.shortExplanation: Expresses change or becoming something; 'to become', 'to turn into', 'to be'.

points.title: Verb て～
points.formation: Verb (Group 1) - Replace last syllable with 〜て, Verb (Group 2) - Replace 'る' with 〜て, Verb (Group 3) - する becomes して, くる becomes きて
points.shortExplanation: A verb conjugation that connects actions or states.

points.title: Verb て います
points.formation: Verb て-form + います
points.shortExplanation: Express ongoing action or state; 'is doing', 'is doing (continuous)', 'has been doing'.

points.title: ～て います
points.formation: Verb て-form + います
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the present continuous or ongoing action; 'to be doing', 'currently doing'.

points.title: Verb て ください
points.formation: Verb-て form + ください
points.shortExplanation: A request or command; 'please do'.

points.title: Verb ないで ください
points.formation: Verb-ない-form + で ください
points.shortExplanation: Used to make a polite request for someone not to do something; 'please don't'.

points.title: Noun の 前に
points.formation: Noun + の + 前に
points.shortExplanation: Used to describe a location or position 'in front of' a noun.

points.title: Verb る 前に
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + 前に
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'before' in a sense of an action must be done before another action or event.
points.usageNote: The everyday "before doing X".

points.title: Noun の あとで
points.formation: Noun + の + あとで
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the order of events; 'after', 'later than'.
points.usageNote: The everyday, plain "after X" - simple sequencing.

points.title: Verb た あとで
points.formation: Verb-た form + あとで
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an action that takes place after another action.

points.title: Verb てから～
points.formation: Verb-て形 + から
points.shortExplanation: Express a sequence of actions or events; 'after', 'since', 'once'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "after doing X, then..." - simple sequencing, doubles as "since" for a state that began at that point.

points.title: ～とき
points.formation: Verb-casual + とき / い-Adjective + とき / な-Adjective + なとき / Noun + のとき
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the time when something happens, 'when', 'at the time'.
points.usageNote: The standard "when" - the everyday default for stating the time something happens.

points.title: ～以来
points.formation: Verb-past + 以来, い-Adjective + 以来, Noun + 以来
points.shortExplanation: Indicates something happening 'since', 'ever since', or 'after' a particular time.
points.usageNote: Formal, written "ever since" - marks a lasting change since a point in time.

points.title: ～末
points.formation: Noun + 末
points.shortExplanation: Express the outcome after a period of time or series of actions; 'after', 'as a result of'.
points.usageNote: Formal, written "after (a long process), finally" - emphasizes the effort/duration before the outcome.

points.title: Noun から Noun まで
points.formation: Noun1 + から + Noun2 + まで
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a range; 'from...to', 'between...and'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "from X to Y" range marker.

points.title: Noun ごろ～
points.formation: Noun + ごろ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'around' or 'about' a certain time or age.
points.usageNote: Same idea as くらい/ぐらい but specifically for a POINT IN TIME ("around 3 o'clock"), not a quantity - doesn't substitute for くらい/ぐらい on quantities.

points.title: Noun くらい～
points.formation: Noun + くらい
points.shortExplanation: Express the extent or degree of something; 'about', 'approximately', 'at least'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, standard way to express an approximate quantity or degree. (Near-duplicate of n3-012 - same word, taught at both N3 and N5.)

points.title: Noun ぐらい～
points.formation: Noun + ぐらい
points.shortExplanation: Express an approximate amount or degree; 'about', 'approximately'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more colloquial than くらい for the same approximate quantity (rendaku softening) - interchangeable in casual speech.

points.title: Verb たいです
points.formation: る-Verb: Remove る and add たいです, う-Verb: Replace the final verb character with the ～い form and add たいです, Exception: する becomes したいです
points.shortExplanation: Express desire or want to do something; 'I want to', 'I would like to'.

points.title: Noun がほしいです
points.formation: Noun + が + ほしいです
points.shortExplanation: Express a desire or wanting something; 'I want', 'I would like'.

points.title: Noun が できます
points.formation: Noun + が + できます
points.shortExplanation: Express the ability to do something.

points.title: Verb ること～
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + こと
points.shortExplanation: Express an action or event as a noun; 'the act of', 'doing'.

points.title: Verb る の～
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + の (casual)
points.shortExplanation: Used to express the purpose or reason in casual speech, or nominalize the verb with の.

points.title: Verb る こと が できます
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ことができます
points.shortExplanation: Express the potential form, or the ability to do something.

points.title: Verb る こと ができる
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ことができる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the potential form; 'can', 'be able to', 'is possible'.
points.usageNote: The standard "can/be able to" construction.

points.title: A は B より～
points.formation: A は B より + Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Express a comparison between A and B; 'A is more/less than B'.

points.title: A より B のほうが～
points.romaji: A yori B no hou ga ～
points.formation: A + より + B + のほうが + Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Used to compare two items; 'B is more ～ than A'.

points.title: A が いちばん～
points.formation: Noun + が + いちばん + Adjective/Verb
points.shortExplanation: Express the superlative degree; 'the most', 'the best', 'the least'.

points.title: Aと Bと どちら～
points.formation: Aと Bと どちら + Verb/Adjective/Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to ask which of two alternatives is preferred or to compare two things

points.title: AとBと どっち〜
points.formation: AとBと どっち + Verb, AかBか どっち + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Asking which one; 'which', 'A or B'.

points.title: Noun も〜
points.formation: Noun + も
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that the action or state is the same for multiple items or people; 'also', 'as well'.
points.usageNote: The plain particle "also/too". (Near-duplicate of n4-118 - same particle, taught at both N4 and N5.)

points.title: Noun と～
points.formation: Noun1 + と + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Express 'with', 'and' or 'together with' when connecting nouns.
points.usageNote: The plain particle "and/with" for connecting nouns.

points.title: Noun や Noun など～
points.formation: Noun1 + や + Noun2 + など
points.shortExplanation: Lists items or examples but not exhaustively; 'such as', 'like', 'and so on'.
points.usageNote: "And, such as" - pairs や (partial "and") with など (etc.).

points.title: Noun か Noun か～
points.formation: Noun1 + か + Noun2 + か～
points.shortExplanation: Expresses choice or alternatives; 'either', 'or'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, everyday "A or B" for simple choices.

points.title: Noun だけ〜
points.formation: Noun + だけ, Verb-casual + だけ, い-Adjective + だけ, な-Adjective-な + だけ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'only', 'just', or 'merely'.
points.usageNote: Simple, neutral "only/just" - the everyday default for stating a plain restriction.

points.title: ～たり、～たり します
points.formation: Verb-casual-past + たり + Verb-casual-past + たり + します
points.shortExplanation: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'do things like', 'and'.
points.usageNote: Lists representative actions rather than nouns/examples - "does things like X and Y" - a different construction from とか/など but the same non-exhaustive-listing idea.

points.title: ～など
points.formation: Noun + など
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a non-exhaustive list of examples; 'such as', 'things like', 'among others'.
points.usageNote: The standard, everyday non-exhaustive list marker - "such as/etc.".

points.title: ～それと～
points.formation: Item1 + それと + Item2
points.shortExplanation: Used to link two or more items; 'and', 'also'.
points.usageNote: Casual "and also" - a conversational way to add an afterthought.

points.title: ～から、～
points.formation: Verb-casual + から / い-Adjective + から / な-Adjective + だから / Noun + だから
points.shortExplanation: Expresses reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'so'.
points.usageNote: Everyday spoken default for stating a reason; emphasizes the speaker's subjective reason.

points.title: ～からです
points.formation: Verb-casual + からです / い-Adjective + からです / な-Adjective + だからです / Noun + だからです
points.shortExplanation: Express the reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
points.usageNote: Polite (です) form of から, typically answering "why?" directly.

points.title: だから、～
points.formation: Noun + だから / な-Adjective + だから
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a reason or cause; 'because', 'so', 'therefore'.
points.usageNote: Blunt, conversational "so"; can sound abrupt or child-like if overused in formal contexts.

points.title: ～なぜなら
points.formation: Sentence/Statement + なぜなら + Reason + から/だから
points.shortExplanation: Express a reason or explanation; 'because', 'the reason is'.
points.usageNote: Formal written connective introducing an explanation ("the reason is..."); essays, articles, speeches.

points.title: ～ことから
points.formation: Verb-casual + ことから / い-Adjective + ことから / な-Adjective + なことから / Noun + のことから
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason or basis for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
points.usageNote: Descriptive/explanatory - "based on the fact that...", common in written explanations rather than casual speech.

points.title: ～が
points.formation: Noun + が / い-Adjective + が / な-Adjective + が / Verb + が
points.shortExplanation: Particle indicating the subject of a sentence or expressing 'but'.
points.usageNote: The plain particle "but"; natural in both speech and writing, softer/more neutral-sounding than けど.

points.title: ～けど、～
points.formation: Verb-casual + けど / い-adjective + けど / な-adjective + だけど / Noun + だけど
points.shortExplanation: Used to connect two clauses; 'but', 'however', 'although'
points.usageNote: Casual, mid-sentence; the everyday spoken default among the "but" family.

points.title: ～けれど、～
points.formation: Verb-casual + けれど / い-Adjective + けれど / な-Adjective + だけれど / Noun + だけれど
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more formal than けど but still conversational; safe in most spoken contexts.

points.title: A。でも、～B。
points.formation: Clause A + でも + Clause B
points.shortExplanation: Used to express contrast between two statements; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.
points.usageNote: Casual speech; fine with friends and family, avoid in writing or formal settings.

points.title: A。しかし、～B。
points.formation: Sentence A + しかし + Sentence B.
points.shortExplanation: Expresses contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.
points.usageNote: Formal/written; essays, news, presentations. Rare in casual spoken conversation.

points.title: A。けれども、～B。
points.formation: Statement A + けれども、+ Statement B
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a contrast between two statements. It can be translated as 'but' or 'however'.
points.usageNote: Formal writing or very polite speech; a business email or public speech, not casual conversation.

points.title: だけど
points.formation: Sentence 1 + (だ)けど + Sentence 2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.
points.usageNote: だ + けど, used after nouns/na-adjectives instead of bare けど. Same register as けど.

points.title: A。だが B。
points.formation: Sentence A + だが + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Expresses contrasting ideas or statements; 'but', 'however'.
points.usageNote: Blunt, assertive "but"; common in writing, speeches, and narration - less soft than けど, less formal-sounding than しかし.

points.title: ～ものの、～
points.formation: Verb-casual + ものの, い-Adjective + ものの, な-Adjective + なものの, Noun + であるものの
points.shortExplanation: Indicates contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'although', 'but'.
points.usageNote: Formal, written register - common in essays and news reporting; rare in casual speech.

points.title: そして、～
points.formation: Sentence 1 + そして + Sentence 2
points.shortExplanation: Used to connect two sentences; 'and then', 'and'.
points.usageNote: The standard connector for sequential sentences - "and/and then"; common in writing too.

points.title: それから、～
points.formation: Clause 1 + それから + Clause 2
points.shortExplanation: Meaning 'after that', 'and then' or 'then', indicating sequence of events.
points.usageNote: Casual, everyday "after that/and then" - simple narrative sequencing.

points.title: A。じゃ、～B。
points.formation: Sentence A. + じゃ、+ Sentence B. (A and B can be any sentence type)
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a decision or suggestion; 'well then', 'in that case', 'so'.
points.usageNote: Casual "well then/so" - the everyday spoken version of それでは.

points.title: A。それじゃ、～B。
points.formation: Sentence A + 。それじゃ、 + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Connect two sentences; 'A, so/in that case, B'

points.title: A。それでは、～B。
points.formation: A (Statement) + 。それでは、 + B (Follow-up action or statement)
points.shortExplanation: Express a change in situation; 'then', 'in that case', 'so'.
points.usageNote: "Well then/in that case" - marks a transition based on what was just said.

points.title: A。 では、～B。
points.formation: Noun A + では、 + Subject + Predicate B
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a contrast or comparison between A and B; 'As for A, ~B'.

points.title: A その上 B
points.formation: A [sentence/clause] + その上 + B [sentence/clause]
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'in addition to', 'besides', or 'furthermore' when adding information or making a suggestion.
points.usageNote: Neutral "on top of that" - conversational-to-written.

points.title: A。おまけに B。
points.formation: Sentence A + おまけに  + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that in addition to A, there is also B; 'moreover', 'besides', 'not only', 'but also'.
points.usageNote: Casual, conversational "on top of that".

points.title: A。しかも B。
points.formation: Statement A + 。しかも + Statement B。
points.shortExplanation: Expressing additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'furthermore'.
points.usageNote: Formal-leaning "moreover" - common in both speech and writing, often for a surprising addition.

points.title: A。なおB。
points.formation: A (sentence) + なお + B (sentence)
points.shortExplanation: Provides additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'in addition'.
points.usageNote: Formal, written "additionally/note that" - common in official notices and documents.

points.title: Verb ましょう
points.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + ましょう
points.shortExplanation: Making a suggestion or invitation; 'let's' or 'shall we'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, direct "let's..." - a plain suggestion/invitation.

points.title: Verb ましょうか。
points.formation: Verb (ます-stem) + ましょうか
points.shortExplanation: Used to make a polite suggestion or offer help; 'shall we', 'should we', 'do you want me to'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "shall we.../shall I..." - offers to do something together or for someone.

points.title: Verb ませんか。
points.formation: Verb (ます-form) + ませんか
points.shortExplanation: An invitation or suggestion; 'won't you', 'why don't you', 'shall we'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more polite/deferential "won't you..." - invites without presuming agreement.

points.title: ～いかがですか。
points.formation: Noun + は + いかがですか / (Verb-て form + は) いかがですか
points.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask someone's thoughts, opinions, or preferences; 'how about', 'how is'.
points.usageNote: Polite "how about..." - asks for a preference/opinion rather than proposing an action directly.

points.title: ～に あげます
points.formation: Receiver + に + Object + を + あげます
points.shortExplanation: Used to express giving something to someone; 'give', 'offer'.
points.usageNote: The plain "give". (Polite ます-form of n4-013's あげる.)

points.title: ～に もらいます
points.formation: Giver + に + Verb-te form + もらいます / Giver + に + Object + を + もらいます
points.shortExplanation: To receive something or some action from someone; 'to get', 'to receive'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, polite (ます) form - the standard textbook way to say "receive".

points.title: ～が 私に くれます
points.formation: Person + が + (Thing or Action) + 私に + くれます
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that someone gives a gift or favor to 'me'; 'someone gives me'.
points.usageNote: Neutral - someone giving TO the speaker. (Polite ます-form of n4-016's くれる.)

points.title: ～から もらいます
points.formation: Noun + から + (Verb-て form) + もらいます
points.shortExplanation: To receive something or get someone to do something.
points.usageNote: The everyday, polite "receive". (から-marked source variant of the もらう family.)

points.title: いつも～
points.formation: いつも + Verb / Adjective / Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expressing 'always' or 'usually' in a sentence.
points.usageNote: "Always/usually" - describes a habitual state or repeated occurrence.

points.title: よく～
points.formation: よく + Verb-casual
points.shortExplanation: Often used to express 'doing something well' or 'often'.

points.title: ときどき～
points.formation: ときどき + Verb/Adjective/Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate the frequency of an event; 'sometimes', 'occasionally', 'now and then'.

points.title: たいてい～
points.formation: たいてい + Verb/い-Adjective/な-Adjective/Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used for expressing 'usually', 'mostly', or 'generally'.

points.title: だいたい〜
points.formation: だいたい + Number/Amount/Percentage
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'roughly', 'approximately', or 'almost'.
points.usageNote: A freestanding adverb ("roughly, for the most part"), not attached to a number like くらい/ぐらい - broader, less precise approximation.

points.title: ほとんど〜
points.formation: ほとんど + Verb / ほとんど + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'almost', 'nearly', or 'most'.
points.usageNote: "Almost/nearly all" - the standard degree-based "almost".

points.title: あまり～ありません
points.formation: あまり + Verb-ないform + ありません / あまり + い-Adjective-く ありません / あまり + な-Adjective・Noun じゃありません
points.shortExplanation: Express 'not very', 'not much', or 'not really' when describing a negative state or situation.

points.title: ぜんぜん～
points.formation: ぜんぜん + [Negative verb/adjective]
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'not at all' or 'completely' in negative sentences.
points.usageNote: The everyday, common "not at all" - very frequent in speech.

points.title: まあまあ～
points.formation: まあまあ (used as an adverb or short expression - not a strict grammatical construction)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses something as 'so-so', 'not bad', or 'average'.

points.title: もっと〜
points.formation: もっと + Verb / い-Adjective / な-Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'more' or 'even more' when describing a quantity, frequency, or degree.

points.title: もう～
points.formation: もう + Verb / もう + Adjective / もう + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'already', 'anymore', or 'soon'.

points.title: まだ〜
points.formation: まだ + Verb (non-past / negative / te-form), まだ + い-adjective, まだ + な-adjective + じゃない/ではない, まだ + Noun + じゃない/ではない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates something has not yet happened or is still happening; 'still', 'not yet'.

points.title: まだ～ません
points.formation: まだ + Verb-ます form (negative)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet (polite form).

points.title: もうすぐ〜
points.formation: もうすぐ + Verb (~ます form or 〜る form)
points.shortExplanation: Express an action or event happening soon: 'soon', 'in a short while', 'almost'.
points.usageNote: "Soon/almost time for" - specifically about time, not degree.

points.title: すぐに～
points.formation: すぐに + Verb/Adjective
points.shortExplanation: Immediately or right away; used to express promptness or quickness.

points.title: さっき～
points.formation: さっき + verb / さっき + phrase
points.shortExplanation: Refers to a short time ago or just now.

points.title: こちら～
points.formation: こちら / こちら + の + Person/Thing
points.shortExplanation: Refers to a person, place or thing; 'this', 'this one', 'this way', 'here'.

points.title: そちら～
points.formation: そちら [alone] / そちら + の + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a direction or person in moderate distance; 'that way', 'that person'.

points.title: ～はたいへんです
points.formation: Noun + はたいへんです
points.shortExplanation: Express that something is difficult or tough.

points.title: Verb た ことがある
points.formation: Verb-た-form + ことがある
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the experience of having done something in the past.

points.title: Verb る ことがある
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことがある
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that something happens sometimes or has happened before.

points.title: Verb ない ことがある
points.formation: Verb-negative form + ことがある
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something doesn't always happen or there are occasions when it doesn't happen.

points.title: Verb られる
points.formation: う-verb (passive): Replace the final う with われる / る-verb (passive & potential): Replace る with られる / Irregular: する → される, くる → こられる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses passive voice or potential form for verbs.

points.title: Verb させる
points.formation: Group 1 Verbs: Change the last hiragana to ～せる, Group 2 Verbs: Remove ～る and add ～させる, Group 3 Verbs: する → させる, くる → こさせる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'to make someone do something', 'to let someone do something', or 'to cause someone to do something'.

points.title: Verb させられる
points.formation: Verb-causative stem + せる + られる (irregular: する→させられる, くる→こさせられる)
points.shortExplanation: Express the passive causative form; 'to be made to', 'to be forced to'.

points.title: ～させてください
points.formation: Verb-causative form + ください
points.shortExplanation: Express a polite request to allow or permit someone to do something.

points.title: Verb て いる
points.formation: Verb (て-form) + いる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an ongoing action or a state resulting from a past action.

points.title: Verb て ある
points.formation: Verb-て form + ある
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that an action has been done and its result is still in effect.

points.title: Verb ておく
points.formation: Verb-て form + おく
points.shortExplanation: Perform an action in preparation for a future situation; 'to do something in advance'.

points.title: Verb てしまう
points.formation: Verb-te form + しまう
points.shortExplanation: Expresses unintentional actions or actions with regrettable outcomes; 'to end up doing', 'to accidentally do'.

points.title: Verb てみる
points.formation: Verb-て form + みる
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'try to' or 'attempt to do'.

points.title: Verb て いく
points.formation: Verb in て-form + いく
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an action that continues on into the future or a change that progresses over time.

points.title: Verb て くる
points.formation: Verb て-form + くる
points.shortExplanation: An action that starts in the past and continues to the present or future; 'come to', 'begin to', 'become'.

points.title: Noun を あげる
points.formation: Noun + を + あげる
points.shortExplanation: To give something to someone; 'give', 'offer', 'present'.
points.usageNote: The plain "give" - speaker giving to someone at equal/lower status.

points.title: Noun を くれる
points.formation: Giver + が + Receiver + に + Noun + を + くれる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that someone gives a thing to the speaker or someone close to the speaker.
points.usageNote: Neutral - someone giving TO the speaker (or the speaker's in-group), equal/lower status giver.

points.title: Noun もらう
points.formation: Noun + を + もらう
points.shortExplanation: To receive or get something from someone; 'to receive', 'to get'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, plain-form counterpart of もらいます - the everyday "receive/get".

points.title: Nounをいただく
points.formation: Noun + を + いただく
points.shortExplanation: To receive or accept something politely; 'to receive', 'to get', 'to accept'.
points.usageNote: Humble/polite - lowers the speaker relative to the giver; used with someone of higher status.

points.title: Nounをくださる
points.formation: Noun + を + くださる
points.shortExplanation: Used to express someone doing something as a favor or for the benefit of the speaker.
points.usageNote: Honorific - someone of higher status giving to the speaker, as a favor.

points.title: Noun を さしあげる
points.formation: Noun + を + さしあげる
points.shortExplanation: A polite way of expressing to give something.
points.usageNote: Humble - the speaker giving to someone of higher status.

points.title: Verb てあげる
points.formation: Verb-て form + あげる
points.shortExplanation: Used to express doing something for someone; 'do something for someone'.
points.usageNote: Neutral - doing something for someone at equal/lower status, as a favor.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb て くれる
points.formation: Verb-te form + くれる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that someone does something for the speaker (or another person in speaker's group); 'to do something for me/us'.
points.usageNote: Neutral - someone doing something for the speaker, as a favor.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb て もらう
points.formation: Verb-て form + もらう
points.shortExplanation: Express receiving a favor or action from someone.
points.usageNote: Neutral - the speaker receiving the favor of someone doing something.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb ていただく
points.formation: Verb-て form + いただく
points.shortExplanation: Used to express receiving someone's favor or help; 'to kindly do'.
points.usageNote: Humble - receiving the favor of someone (usually higher-status) doing something.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb て くださる
points.formation: Verb て-form + くださる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses gratitude for receiving someone's favor; 'to kindly do'.
points.usageNote: Honorific - someone of higher status doing something for the speaker, as a favor.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb て + さしあげる
points.formation: Verb-てform + さしあげる
points.shortExplanation: A polite way to express giving or doing something for someone.
points.usageNote: Humble - the speaker doing something for someone of higher status, as a favor.
points.familyName: Benefactive Action (Doing X As A Favor)

points.title: Verb てくれませんか
points.formation: Verb-て form + くれませんか
points.shortExplanation: A polite way to request someone to do something for you; 'Could you please', 'Would you please', 'Won't you'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, everyday "could you..." - casual-to-neutral request.

points.title: Verb てもらえませんか
points.formation: Verb-て form + もらえませんか
points.shortExplanation: A polite way to ask for a favor or request someone to do something.
points.usageNote: Neutral "could you..." - similar register to てくれませんか, slightly softer.

points.title: Verb てもらいたい
points.formation: Verb-て-form + もらいたい
points.shortExplanation: Express a desire to receive a favor or service from someone else.
points.usageNote: Neutral "I'd like you to..." - less formal than ていただきたい.

points.title: Verb ていただきたい
points.formation: Verb-て form + いただきたい
points.shortExplanation: Express a polite request or desire that someone does something for you.
points.usageNote: Polite "I would like you to..." - a statement of desire rather than a direct question.

points.title: Verb て いただけませんか
points.formation: Verb-て form + いただけませんか
points.shortExplanation: A polite request; 'Could you please...', 'Would you mind...'
points.usageNote: The most formal/humble request form - "could you possibly...".

points.title: Verb て くださいませんか
points.formation: Verb in て-form + くださいませんか
points.shortExplanation: Polite request for asking someone for a favor.
points.usageNote: Formal but common - "would you please...".

points.title: ～ないといけない
points.formation: Verb-negative + といけない
points.shortExplanation: Express a necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
points.usageNote: Conversational but not as casual as なきゃ/なくちゃ; common in everyday polite speech.

points.title: ～なきゃいけない
points.formation: Verb-casual (negative form without い) + なきゃいけない
points.shortExplanation: Express a necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
points.usageNote: Casual contraction (なければ→なきゃ); the most common everyday spoken form.

points.title: ～なくちゃいけない
points.formation: Verb-ない form (-ない ending is dropped) + なくちゃいけない
points.shortExplanation: Express the obligation to do something; 'have to', 'must', 'need to'.
points.usageNote: Casual contraction (なくては→なくちゃ); spoken, informal.

points.title: ～なくてはいけない
points.formation: Verb-negative form + なくてはいけない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.
points.usageNote: Slightly less stiff than なければならない, still fine in most polite contexts.

points.title: ～なければ ならない
points.formation: Verb-ない form + なければ ならない
points.shortExplanation: Express obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
points.usageNote: The full, uncontracted form; safe in writing and formal speech.

points.title: ～なくてもいい
points.formation: Verb-ない-form + てもいい
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is not necessary to do; 'it's okay if not', 'don't have to'.

points.title: ～てもいい
points.formation: Verb-て form + もいい
points.shortExplanation: To give or ask permission; 'it's okay to', 'may', 'can'.

points.title: ～てはいけない
points.formation: Verb-て-form + はいけない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot'.
points.usageNote: Everyday prohibition; common in daily instructions and rules (including for children) - less stiff than てはならない.

points.title: ～ねばならない
points.formation: Verb-ない form → (remove い) → ね + ばならない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.
points.usageNote: Literary/legal-sounding contraction of なければならない; textbook and formal writing register, rare in speech.

points.title: ～てはならない
points.formation: Verb-て form + はならない
points.shortExplanation: Express prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot', 'should not'.
points.usageNote: Strong, formal prohibition; common in rules, warnings, and formal speech.

points.title: ～べきではない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べき + ではない
points.shortExplanation: Express that an action should not be done; 'should not', 'ought not to'.
points.usageNote: Formal normative judgment - "should not", based on what's proper or expected, not a hard rule.

points.title: Verb たほうがいい
points.formation: Verb (past tense) + ほうがいい
points.shortExplanation: Used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone - 'it's better if...'.

points.title: Verb ないほうがいい
points.formation: Verb-negative form + ほうがいい
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that it is better not to do something.

points.title: ～たらいい
points.formation: Verb-casual-past + たらいい
points.shortExplanation: Expressing a desire or suggestion for a particular outcome; 'it would be good if', 'should', 'I hope'.
points.usageNote: Casual, softer suggestion - "it'd be good if.../I hope...".

points.title: ～たら いかがですか
points.formation: Verb-casual, past + たら いかがですか, い-Adjective + かったら いかがですか, な-Adjective + だったら いかがですか, Noun + だったら いかがですか
points.shortExplanation: Making polite suggestions; 'how about if', 'what if', 'it would be good if'.
points.usageNote: Polite, formal suggestion - "how about...?" - much more formal than たらいい/ばいい, used with someone you should be respectful toward.

points.title: ～たら どうですか
points.formation: Verb-た form + ら どうですか
points.shortExplanation: Express a suggestion or advice; 'what if', 'how about', 'why don't you'.

points.title: ～といい
points.formation: Verb-casual + といい, い-Adjective + といい, な-Adjective + だといい, Noun + だといい
points.shortExplanation: Express a wish or hope; 'I hope', 'it would be good if'.
points.usageNote: Casual "I hope.../it'd be nice if..." - similar register to たらいい/ばいい.

points.title: ～ばいい
points.formation: Verb-ば-form + いい, い-Adjective + ければいい, な-Adjective + であればいい, Noun + であればいい
points.shortExplanation: Express a suggestion or advice; 'should', 'it would be good if'.
points.usageNote: Casual, softer suggestion - "it'd be good if...", near-identical register to たらいい.

points.title: Verb なさい
points.formation: Verb-stem + なさい
points.shortExplanation: A command form used to give orders or instructions; 'Please do', 'Do this'.

points.title: Verb つもり
points.formation: Verb-casual + つもり
points.shortExplanation: Express the intention, plan, or determination to do something; 'I intend to', 'I plan to', 'I'm determined to'.
points.usageNote: The plain-form "intend to/plan to".

points.title: Verb ようと思う
points.formation: Verb-volitional + と思う
points.shortExplanation: Express intention or plan to do something; 'I think I will', 'I plan to', 'I intend to'.
points.usageNote: "I think I will.../I plan to" - a slightly softer statement of intention than つもりだ.

points.title: Verb ために
points.formation:
1) Verb (dictionary form) + ために (purpose)
2) い-Adjective + ために (reason)
3) な-Adjective + な + ために (reason)
4) Noun + の + ために (reason)
points.shortExplanation: Used to describe the purpose or reason for an action; 'for the sake of', 'in order to', 'because of'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, common purpose marker - "for the sake of/in order to"; safe in most contexts. (Verb-attached form of n4-010's のために.)

points.title: のために
points.formation: Noun + のために
points.shortExplanation: Used to express purpose or reason; 'for', 'for the sake of', 'in order to'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, common purpose marker - "for the sake of/in order to"; safe in most contexts.

points.title: Verb ように
points.formation: Examples: Noun + のように / Verb-casual + ように / い-adjective + ように
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'like', 'as if', 'in order to', or 'so that'.
points.usageNote: Softer purpose marker, typically paired with potential-form or state verbs. (Near-duplicate of n3-112 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

points.title: Verb ようにする
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ようにする
points.shortExplanation: Make an effort to; try to; see to it that; ensure that.

points.title: Verb ようになる
points.formation: Verb-dictionary/potential form + ようになる
points.shortExplanation: Express a change in ability, situation or state; 'become able to', 'come to', 'begin to'.

points.title: Verb ように言う
points.formation: Verb-casual + ように言う
points.shortExplanation: Tell someone to do something; 'tell to do', 'instruct to do'.

points.title: ～つもりだ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + つもりだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan.
points.usageNote: The standard "intend to/plan to".

points.title: ～つもりで
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + つもりで
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan; 'with the intention of', 'planning to'.
points.usageNote: The standard "intend to/plan to", used adverbially before another clause.

points.title: ～かもしれない
points.formation: Verb-casual + かもしれない, い-Adjective + かもしれない, な-Adjective + だかもしれない, Noun + だかもしれない
points.shortExplanation: Express uncertainty; 'maybe', 'might', 'possibly'.
points.usageNote: The everyday hedge for possibility - "maybe/might".

points.title: ～だろう
points.formation: Verb-casual + だろう, い-Adjective (drop い) + だろう, な-Adjective + だろう, Noun + だろう
points.shortExplanation: Express probability, likelihood or certainty; 'probably', 'maybe', 'I think'.
points.usageNote: Casual conjecture - "probably", the plain-form counterpart of でしょう.

points.title: ～でしょう
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + でしょう, い-Adjective + でしょう, な-Adjective + でしょう, Noun + でしょう
points.shortExplanation: A conjecture or probability; 'probably', 'I think', 'it seems'.
points.usageNote: Polite conjecture - "probably/I think", softer and more polite than だろう.

points.title: ～ようだ
points.formation: Verb-て form + ようだ, い-Adjective (drop い) + ようだ, な-Adjective + のようだ, Noun + のようだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses appearance, similarity or inference; 'it seems', 'it looks like', 'it appears'.
points.usageNote: Inference from one's own senses/observation - "it looks like/it seems (based on what I see)".

points.title: ～みたいだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + みたいだ, い-Adjective + みたいだ, な-Adjective + みたいだ, Noun + みたいだ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates similarity, resemblance or 'like'; 'it seems', 'appears', 'looks like'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken "seems like/looks like" - the everyday default for resemblance. (Near-duplicate of n3-103 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

points.title: ～そうだ
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + そうだ, い-Adjective (without い) + そうだ, な-Adjective + そうだ
points.shortExplanation: Express the appearance, seeming, or feeling of something; 'looks like', 'seems', 'appears'.

points.title: ～かしら
points.formation: Verb-casual + かしら, い-Adjective + かしら, な-Adjective + かしら, Noun + かしら
points.shortExplanation: Indicates uncertainty or doubt; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
points.usageNote: Casual, traditionally feminine-coded "I wonder" - softer, more old-fashioned than かなあ.

points.title: ～かなあ
points.formation: Verb-casual + かなあ, い-Adjective + かなあ, (な-Adjective/Noun) + (だ) + かなあ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses uncertainty or wonder; 'I wonder', 'I'm not sure'.
points.usageNote: Casual, unisex "I wonder" - a soft, musing tone. (Near-duplicate of n3-006 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

points.title: ～んだって
points.formation: Verb-casual + んだって, い-Adjective + んだって, な-Adjective + なんだって, Noun + なんだって
points.shortExplanation: Conveys information heard from someone else; 'I heard', 'They said'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken hearsay - "I heard (that)...", conversational tone.

points.title: ～かのようだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + かのようだ, い-Adjective + かのようだ, な-Adjective + であるかのようだ, Noun + であるかのようだ
points.shortExplanation: Express a similarity or comparison; 'as if', 'like', 'as though'.
points.usageNote: Formal "as if/as though" - a deliberate, considered comparison; common in writing.

points.title: ～と思う
points.formation: Verb-casual + と思う, い-Adjective + と思う, な-Adjective + だと思う, Noun + だと思う
points.shortExplanation: Express one's thoughts or opinions; 'I think', 'I believe'.

points.title: ～という
points.formation: Verb-casual + という, い-Adjective + という, な-Adjective + という, Noun + という
points.shortExplanation: Used to quote, express hearsay or define something.

points.title: ～という (〜to iu) Noun
points.formation: Noun + という + Noun, な-Adjective + という + Noun, Adjectival Verb + という + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to define or explain a noun more specifically.

points.title: ～っていう
points.formation: Noun/Adjective/Verb + っていう + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to quote, define, or specify a noun.

points.title: どういう Noun
points.formation: どういう + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Asking for clarification or more information about a noun; 'what kind of', 'what sort of'.

points.title: ～かどうか
points.formation: Verb-casual + かどうか, い-Adjective + かどうか, な-Adjective + (だ)かどうか, Noun + (だ)かどうか
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'whether' or 'if' in indirect questions or statements.

points.title: ～のです
points.formation: Verb-casual + のです, い-Adjective + のです, な-Adjective + なのです, Noun + なのです
points.shortExplanation: Provides an explanation or gives background information; 'the fact is', 'the reason is', 'actually'.
points.usageNote: "The fact is/the reason is" - explains or justifies with a bit more formality than んです.

points.title: ～んです
points.formation: Verb-casual + んです, い-Adjective + んです, な-Adjective + なんです, Noun + なんです
points.shortExplanation: Provide an explanation or reason; 'it is that', 'the thing is', 'the reason is'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken contraction of のです - the everyday explanatory tone.

points.title: ～ので
points.formation: Verb-casual + ので, い-Adjective + ので, な-Adjective + なので, Noun + なので
points.shortExplanation: Express a reason or a cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'so'.
points.usageNote: Softer and more objective-sounding than から; common in polite/formal spoken Japanese and written explanations.

points.title: ～のに
points.formation: Verb-casual + のに, い-Adjective + のに, な-Adjective + なのに, Noun + なのに
points.shortExplanation: Used to express contrast between expectation and reality, or to indicate a purpose for doing something

points.title: ～し、～し、～
points.formation: Verb-casual + し, い-Adjective + し, な-Adjective + だし, Noun + だし
points.shortExplanation: Express multiple reasons or characteristics; 'and', 'because', 'since'.
points.usageNote: Lists multiple reasons casually-to-neutrally; implies "and there's more I could add".

points.title: Verb た ときに
points.formation: Verb-た + ときに
points.shortExplanation: Express an action or event that occurred at a specific time in the past; 'when', 'at the time'.
points.usageNote: Past-tense form of とき - not a different register, just a different verb tense.

points.title: Verb るときに
points.formation: Verb-る + ときに
points.shortExplanation: Describes the time when a certain action takes place; 'when', 'at the time'.
points.usageNote: Non-past form of とき - not a different register, just a different verb tense.

points.title: Noun の 間に
points.formation: Noun + の間に
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'during' a specific period or time.
points.usageNote: Simple time-window marker - "during (a period)".

points.title: Verb ている間に
points.formation: Verb-て form + いる + 間に
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'during the time' something is happening.
points.usageNote: "While (an ongoing action continues)" - pairs with an ongoing verb.

points.title: ～までに
points.formation: Verb-casual + までに, Noun + までに, Time expression + までに
points.shortExplanation: Express 'by' or 'before' a certain time or action.
points.usageNote: The standard way to mark a deadline - "by (a time)".

points.title: Noun + 中
points.formation: Noun + 中 (ちゅう)
points.shortExplanation: Express 'in the middle of', 'during', or 'in the process of'.
points.usageNote: Attaches directly to a noun (e.g. 食事中 "during a meal") - "in the middle of/during".

points.title: Verb て いる ところ
points.formation: Verb-て form + いる ところ
points.shortExplanation: Describes an action that is currently happening; 'in the middle of', 'in the process of'.
points.usageNote: "In the middle of doing X" - pairs with an ongoing action verb, more explicit than bare ところ.

points.title: Verb た ところ
points.formation: Verb (た form) + ところ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the situation right after an action has taken place.

points.title: Verb る ところ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ところ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the state or moment when an action is about to happen or is happening.

points.title: Verb ながら
points.formation: Verb-masu stem + ながら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'as' in the sense of doing two things simultaneously.
points.usageNote: The everyday "while doing X" for two simultaneous actions.

points.title: ～つつ
points.formation: Verb-stem + つつ
points.shortExplanation: Shows two actions happening simultaneously or a contrast; 'while', 'although'.
points.usageNote: Literary version of ながら; can also carry a contrastive nuance ("while, even though").

points.title: Verb 出す
points.formation: Verb stem + 出す (~dasu)
points.shortExplanation: Express the action of taking something out, starting an action, or emphasizing a verb.

points.title: Verb 終わる
points.formation: 終わる (owaru) is a godan (u-verb)
points.shortExplanation: Verbal action is completed; 'to finish', 'to end'.

points.title: Verb + 続ける
points.formation: Verb-masu-stem + 続ける
points.shortExplanation: To continue doing or to keep doing an action.

points.title: Verb にくい
points.formation: Verb-stem + にくい
points.shortExplanation: Express difficulty or complexity; 'hard to', 'difficult to', 'not easily'.

points.title: Verb やすい
points.formation: Verb-stem + やすい
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is easy to do; 'easy to', 'easy for'.

points.title: ～すぎる
points.formation: Verb-stem + すぎる, い-Adjective (remove い) + すぎる, な-Adjective + すぎる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is excessive or overdone; 'too much', 'too', 'over'.

points.title: Verb 方
points.formation: Verb-stem + 方 (read as かた)
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the way or method of doing something; often read as '～かた' ('how to', 'the way of').

points.title: A は B ほど～ありません
points.formation: A は B ほど Verb/adjective ありません
points.shortExplanation: Express that A is not as much as B; 'not as... as', 'not... to the extent of'.

points.title: A は B ほど～ない
points.formation: A は B ほど + い-Adjective stem (without い) + くない, な-Adjective + じゃない, Verb-negative potential form
points.shortExplanation: Expressing that A is not as ~ as B; 'not as...as'

points.title: A より B のほうが〜
points.romaji: A yori B no hou ga 〜
points.formation: A + より + B + のほうが + Adjective/Verb
points.shortExplanation: Comparing two things; 'B is more ~ than A'.

points.title: Noun しか～ない
points.formation: Noun + しか + Negative Verb
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', or 'no other'.
points.usageNote: Paired with a negative verb for emphasis - "nothing but/only", stronger than だけ.

points.title: Noun ばかり
points.formation: Noun + ばかり, Verb-casual + ばかり, い-Adjective + ばかり, な-Adjective + だ ばかり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', 'always', or 'just'.
points.usageNote: Often implies excess or repetition - "always doing X/nothing but X" - can sound like a complaint. (Near-duplicate of n3-087 - same word, taught at both N3 and N4.)

points.title: ～まで
points.formation: Verb + まで, い-Adjective + まで, な-Adjective + まで, Noun + まで
points.shortExplanation: Indicates extent, 'until', 'up to', 'as far as', 'even'.
points.usageNote: Casual-to-neutral "even/to the point of" - overlaps with さえ in everyday speech.

points.title: ～ずつ
points.formation: Noun + ずつ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates equal distribution; 'each', 'per', 'apiece'.

points.title: い-Adjective く する/なる
points.formation: い-Adjective (remove い) + く + する/なる
points.shortExplanation: Express a change happening or making something change.

points.title: な-adjective に する/なる
points.formation: な-Adjective + に + する/なる
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate change or decision; 'to become' or 'to make' with na-adjectives.

points.title: Noun に する
points.formation: Noun + に + する
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate a choice or decision, 'to decide on' or 'to choose'.

points.title: Noun に なる
points.formation: Noun + に + なる
points.shortExplanation: To become; to change into; to turn into.

points.title: Verb ない + ことにする
points.formation: Verb-ない form + ことにする
points.shortExplanation: To decide not to do something.

points.title: Verb ない ことになる
points.formation: Verb-negative (ない) + ことになる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a result; 'end up not', 'it will become that', 'it would mean that'.

points.title: Verb ることにする
points.formation: Verb-る + ことにする
points.shortExplanation: Decide to do something, make a decision.

points.title: Verb る ことになる
points.formation: Verb-る + ことになる
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something has been decided or arranged; 'it has been decided that', 'it turns out that'.

points.title: ～ても/でも
points.formation: Verb-て-form + も, い-Adjective (-い) + くても, な-Adjective + でも, Noun + でも
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even if' or 'even though'; used to convey contradiction or contrast.
points.usageNote: "Even if" - a hypothetical/conditional even-though, not a factual contrast. Distinguish from the others, which describe something already true.

points.title: ～まま
points.formation: Verb-てform + いる+ まま, Adjective (い & な) + まま, Noun + のまま
points.shortExplanation: Express 'as it is', 'while' or 'unchanged state'.

points.title: ～で
points.formation: Noun + ～で
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the means, method, or place.

points.title: ～に
points.formation: Noun + に
points.shortExplanation: Indicates direction, destination, purpose, or time.

points.title: そんな (sonna) + Noun
points.formation: そんな + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'that kind/type of'; referring to something near the listener or previously mentioned.

points.title: そんなに～
points.formation: そんなに + Verb-negation, そんなに + Adjective-negation
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not so much', 'not that', or 'not so ~'.

points.title: ～たり～たり
points.formation: Verb-ta + り + next verb-ta + り, い-Adjective + かったり + next verb-ta + り, な-Adjective + だったり + next verb-ta + り, Noun + だったり + next verb-ta + り
points.shortExplanation: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'doing things like', 'and so on', 'etc.'

points.title: Verb て ほしい
points.formation: Verb-て form + ほしい
points.shortExplanation: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want (someone) to'.

points.title: 文A。そのうえ 文B。
points.formation: Sentence A + そのうえ + Sentence B + 。
points.shortExplanation: Shows additional information; 'furthermore', 'besides', 'in addition'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "on top of that". (Same word as n3-001's その上, kana-written; taught at N4.)

points.title: 文A。それで 文B
points.formation: Sentence A。それで Sentence B。
points.shortExplanation: Used to connect two sentences; 'So', 'That's why', 'Therefore'.
points.usageNote: Casual "and then/so" - conversational, often prompts the listener for what happened next. (Near-duplicate of n2-011's それで, sentence-initial form.)

points.title: 文A。それに 文B
points.formation: Sentence A + それに + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Express 'in addition to; besides,' used to include additional information.

points.title: A とか B とか
points.formation: Noun + とか + Noun + とか
points.shortExplanation: Used to express multiple examples or possibilities; 'such as', 'like', 'for example'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken "such as/or something". (Near-duplicate pattern of n2-094's とか, doubled for two examples.)

points.title: ～おかげで
points.formation: Verb-casual + おかげで, い-Adjective + おかげで, な-Adjective + だおかげで, Noun + のおかげで
points.shortExplanation: Expresses gratitude or shows a positive result due to a certain factor; 'thanks to', 'because of'.
points.usageNote: Implies a positive/grateful outcome - "thanks to X" - unlike the other causality markers, this one always frames the cause favorably.

points.title: ～んだもん
points.formation: Verb-casual + んだもん, い-Adjective + んだもん, な-Adjective + なんだもん, Noun + なんだもん
points.shortExplanation: Used to convey a sense of justification; 'because', 'that's why', 'it's just that'.
points.usageNote: Very casual, whiny/pouty justification; strongly associated with children or exaggerated pouting for effect.

points.title: ～くせに
points.formation: Verb-casual + くせに, い-Adjective + くせに, な-Adjective + な/のくせに, Noun + のくせに
points.shortExplanation: Used to express criticism or disapproval; 'even though', 'despite', 'in spite of'.
points.usageNote: Carries criticism/disdain - "even though X, (which makes Y worse/hypocritical)". Never neutral; always judgmental.

points.title: ～といっても
points.formation: Verb-casual + といっても, い-Adjective + といっても, な-Adjective + だといっても, Noun + だといっても
points.shortExplanation: Express the meaning 'even though', 'although', 'but'.
points.usageNote: "Even though X is true, don't over-assume" - tempers/qualifies a preceding statement, not a plain contrast.

points.title: ～ところが
points.formation: Phrase 1 (expected situation) + ところが + Phrase 2 (unexpected result)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a contrast or unexpected outcome; 'however', 'but', 'even though'.
points.usageNote: Introduces an unexpected/surprising outcome; storytelling register, implies surprise rather than plain contrast.

points.title: ～わりには
points.formation: Verb-casual + わりには, い-Adjective + わりには, な-Adjective + だわりには, Noun + だわりには
points.shortExplanation: Expresses contrast between expectation and reality; 'despite', 'considering', 'even though'.
points.usageNote: "Despite X, less/more than expected" - a comparison against expectation, not a plain contrast.

points.title: もし～たなら
points.formation: もし + Verb-casual past + なら, もし + い-Adjective-casual past + なら, もし + な-Adjective + だったなら, もし + Noun + だったなら
points.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical condition, 'if' or 'in case'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "if" - もし signals a hypothetical up front.

points.title: もしも～なら
points.formation: Verb-casual + なら, い-Adjective + なら, な-Adjective + なら, Noun + なら
points.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical condition or situation; 'if', 'in case', 'suppose'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more emphatic version of もし～たなら.

points.title: ～さえ
points.formation: Noun + さえ, Verb-casual + さえ, い-Adjective + さえ, な-Adjective + でさえ
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes a specific item or action; 'even', 'if only', 'as long as'.
points.usageNote: The common, everyday emphasis marker "even".

points.title: ～まで
points.formation: Verb-casual + まで, い-Adjective + まで, な-Adjective + まで, Noun + まで
points.shortExplanation: Express 'until', 'up to', or 'as far as' to indicate the end point of an action or range.
points.usageNote: Casual-to-neutral "even/to the point of" - overlaps with さえ in everyday speech. (Same word as n4-114's まで, extent/until sense.)

points.title: ～たとえ～ても
points.formation: たとえ + Verb-casual + ても, たとえ + い-Adjective + くても, たとえ + な-Adjective + であっても, たとえ + Noun + であっても
points.shortExplanation: Express a condition with 'even if'; 'no matter how'.
points.usageNote: The standard "even if" - pairs たとえ with ても for emphasis.

points.title: どんなに～ても
points.formation: どんなに + Verb-てform + も, どんなに + い-Adjective-てform + も, どんなに + な-Adjective + でも
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'no matter how much' or 'even if'; emphasizes the degree of a situation.
points.usageNote: "No matter how much" - emphasizes degree, not just possibility.

points.title: ～にしても
points.formation: Verb-casual + にしても, い-Adjective + にしても, な-Adjective + だにしても, Noun + だにしても
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even if', 'no matter', 'regardless of'.
points.usageNote: "Even granting/regardless of" - softer, more conversational than たとえ～ても.

points.title: もし～ても
points.formation: もし + Verb-て form + も / もし + い-Adjective(く) + ても / もし + な-Adjective/Noun + でも
points.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical situation or assumption with the nuance of 'even if'.
points.usageNote: Pairs もし with ても - a plain hypothetical "even if".

points.title: ～しかない
points.formation: Verb-casual + しかない, い-Adjective + しかない, な-Adjective + しかない, Noun + しかない
points.shortExplanation: Express the idea of 'only', 'no other option but', 'nothing else but'.
points.usageNote: "No other option but" - emphasizes lack of alternatives, not just restriction.

points.title: ～だけしか
points.formation: Noun/Quantity + だけ + しか + Negative Verb
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the scarcity or insufficiency of something; 'only', 'nothing but'.
points.usageNote: Combines だけ+しか for extra emphasis on the restriction - "only, and nothing else".

points.title: ～ということだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + ということだ, い-Adjective + ということだ, な-Adjective + だということだ, Noun + だということだ
points.shortExplanation: Express a conclusion or hearsay; 'I heard', 'it means', 'it can be said'.
points.usageNote: Hearsay - "I heard that/it's said that" - similar to らしい but frames it as a direct report.

points.title: もしかすると〜かもしれない
points.formation: もしかすると + Sentence + かもしれない
points.shortExplanation: Express the possibility of something; 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'might'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more deliberate/emphasized version of かもしれない, often introducing a surprising possibility.

points.title: ～らしい
points.formation: Verb-casual + らしい, い-Adjective + らしい, な-Adjective + だらしい, Noun + だらしい
points.shortExplanation: Expresses hearsay; 'I heard', 'it seems', 'apparently'.
points.usageNote: Hearsay-based - "I heard that/apparently", based on external information rather than personal judgment.

points.title: ～かわりに
points.formation: Verb-casual + かわりに, い-Adjective + かわりに, な-Adjective + だかわりに, Noun + だかわりに
points.shortExplanation: In place of; instead of; as a substitute for.
points.usageNote: Neutral, flexible "instead of" - can follow a verb phrase ("instead of doing X, I did Y").

points.title: ～にかわって
points.formation: Noun + にかわって
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'in place of', 'on behalf of', or 'instead of'.
points.usageNote: Formal "on behalf of/in place of" - noun-only, typically for substituting people/entities.

points.title: すこしも〜ない
points.formation: すこしも + Verb-negative
points.shortExplanation: Express a negative state or action; 'not at all', 'none whatsoever'.
points.usageNote: "Not even a little" - a slightly more deliberate way to deny completely.

points.title: 決して～ない
points.formation: 決して + Verb (negative form)
points.shortExplanation: Express 'never', 'by no means', or 'not at all' when negating a statement.
points.usageNote: Emphatic "never/by no means" - stronger and more deliberate than ぜんぜん; common in writing and serious statements.

points.title: ～つまり
points.formation: Sentence A + つまり + Sentence B (rephrasing)
points.shortExplanation: Summarizing, restating, or clarifying a point: 'in other words', 'that is to say'.
points.usageNote: The standard "in other words" - summarizes or restates a point.

points.title: ～という
points.formation: Noun + という + Noun, Verb-casual + という + Noun, い-Adjective + という + Noun, な-Adjective + という + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used for quoting, defining, or giving an example; 'called', 'that is to say', 'like'.
points.usageNote: General-purpose "called/that is to say" - quoting or naming something.

points.title: ～きり
points.formation: Verb-past + きり, Verb-てform + きり (less common), Noun + きり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'only', 'since', or 'after'.
points.usageNote: "Only/since then" - a one-time event with a lasting effect, similar to たきり but broader (also means "only").

points.title: ～たところ
points.formation: Verb-た form + ところ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the result or outcome of an action; 'after', 'just when', 'upon'.
points.usageNote: "Just when/upon doing X" - often introduces an unexpected discovery.

points.title: ～ことだ
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + ことだ, い-Adjective + ことだ, な-Adjective + なことだ, Noun + のことだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses advice or recommendation; 'should', 'it is important', 'it is necessary'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, direct advice - "you should.../it's important to...".

points.title: ～はずだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + はずだ, い-Adjective + はずだ, な-Adjective + なはずだ, Noun + のはずだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an expectation, 'should' or 'it is supposed to'.
points.usageNote: Expresses an expectation based on reasoning, not advice - "it should be the case that...".

points.title: ～ついでに
points.formation: Verb (dictionary or た-form) + ついでに, Noun + の + ついでに, or Verb-て form + いる + ついでに
points.shortExplanation: Do something while or after completing another action; 'while', 'by the way'.
points.usageNote: "While I'm at it" - doing something extra alongside the main action, not purely a topic shift.

points.title: ところで
points.formation: ところで + new topic or question
points.shortExplanation: Used for changing the topic or bringing up a new topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of'.
points.usageNote: The standard, most common "by the way" topic-change marker.

points.title: ～うちに
points.formation: Verb-てform + いる + うちに, い-Adjective + い + うちに, な-Adjective + な + うちに
points.shortExplanation: Express 'while', 'before', or 'during' a certain condition or situation.
points.usageNote: "While (a temporary condition holds)" - implies acting before the window closes. (Near-duplicate of n2-040 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～うとした
points.formation: Verb-う stem + とした
points.shortExplanation: Express an action someone tried to do but couldn't; 'tried to', 'attempted to'.

points.title: ～かけ
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + かけ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of being in the middle of doing something or of something being partway done.

points.title: ～ないで
points.formation: Verb-ない-form + で
points.shortExplanation: Express 'without doing ~' or 'without ~ing'.

points.title: ～から～にかけて
points.formation: Noun (time, place, or measure) + から + Noun (time, place or measure) + にかけて
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a range of something, such as time or space; 'from...to', 'between'.
points.usageNote: "From X to Y (roughly, over a span)". (Near-duplicate of n2-055 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～くらい～は～ない
points.formation: Verb-casual (non-past) + くらい + は + Verb-casual (negative), Adjective (non-past) + くらい + は + Adjective (negative)
points.shortExplanation: Express the least one can do; 'at least', 'the least', 'no less than'.
points.usageNote: "At least this much, surely" - sets a low bar that should be achievable.

points.title: ～こそ
points.formation: Noun + こそ, (Verb-て + こそ)
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the importance or uniqueness of something or someone; 'precisely', 'exactly', 'it is...', 'of all...'.

points.title: ～こと
points.formation: Verb-plain form + こと, Verb-phrase in plain form + こと
points.shortExplanation: Express an action in a nominal (noun-like) form or state fact or experience.

points.title: ～ことにしている
points.formation: Verb-casual + ことにしている
points.shortExplanation: Express a personal rule or habit; 'I make it a rule to', 'I always make sure to'.

points.title: ～ことになっている
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことになっている
points.shortExplanation: Describes something that is decided, arranged, or expected.

points.title: ～ことは…が
points.formation: Verb-casual + ことは + が, い-Adjective + ことは + が, な-Adjective + だ + ことは + が, Noun + だ + ことは + が
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that while something may be true or valid, there is another contrasting point.

points.title: ～ことはない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことはない, い-Adjective + ことはない, な-Adjective + であることはない, Noun + であることはない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something doesn't need to be done or there's no occasion to do it; 'don't have to', 'not necessary'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "there's no need to/no occasion to".

points.title: ～さ
points.formation: い-Adjective (drop い) + さ, な-Adjective + さ
points.shortExplanation: Express the degree or extent of a quality; '-ness', 'degree of'.

points.title: ～ずに
points.formation: Verb-ない form (Remove ない) + ずに
points.shortExplanation: Express 'without doing' something or 'not doing' something.

points.title: ～せいで
points.formation: Verb-casual + せいで, い-Adjective + せいで, な-Adjective + なせいで, Noun + のせいで
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something or someone caused an unfortunate result.

points.title: ～せてください
points.formation: Verb-causative (させ) + て + ください
points.shortExplanation: Requesting someone to allow or let you do something (causative request).

points.title: ～そのために
points.formation: Sentence/phrase 1 + そのために + Sentence/phrase 2
points.shortExplanation: For the purpose of; because of; in order to.

points.title: ～その結果
points.formation: Situation/ACTION 1 + その結果 + RESULT
points.shortExplanation: Shows the result or consequence of a previous action or situation; 'as a result', 'in consequence'.

points.title: ～？それとも～？
points.formation: Verb-casual + ？それとも + Verb-casual + ？, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Presents two alternatives or choices; 'or', 'either...or'.
points.usageNote: "Or (alternatively)" - used between two full question options.

points.title: ～たて
points.formation: Verb-stem + たて
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an action that has just been completed; 'freshly', 'just'.

points.title: ～たとたん
points.formation: Verb-た form + とたん
points.shortExplanation: Express the moment something happens; 'as soon as', 'the moment', 'the instant'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, emphasizes the immediacy/suddenness of what follows. (Near-duplicate of n2-072 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～たびに
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + たびに, Noun + のたびに
points.shortExplanation: Express 'every time' or 'whenever'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "every time/whenever".

points.title: ～だものだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + んだものだ, い-Adjective + んだものだ, な-Adjective + なんだものだ, Noun + なんだものだ (often with から as んだものだから)
points.shortExplanation: Express the reason or cause, often used to justify something.

points.title: ～ちゃった
points.formation: Verb-て/で form → ちゃった/じゃった (e.g. 食べてしまった → 食べちゃった)
points.shortExplanation: Express an unintentional action or a regretful action; 'ended up doing', 'did accidentally'.

points.title: ～っけ？
points.formation: Verb-casual + っけ?, い-Adjective + かったっけ?, な-Adjective/Noun + だっけ?
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that one is trying to recall some information.

points.title: ～っぱい
points.formation: Noun + で + いっぱい (Note: written as いっぱい, read as 'ippai')
points.shortExplanation: Expresses fullness or completeness; 'full', 'full of', 'filled with'.

points.title: ～っぱなし
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + っぱなし
points.shortExplanation: Indicate a state where an action is left as is (unchanged or unfinished).

points.title: ～つもりでした
points.formation: Verb-casual (dictionary form) + つもりでした
points.shortExplanation: Expressing a past intention or plan; 'was planning to', 'meant to'.
points.usageNote: Past-tense "was planning to/meant to (but didn't necessarily follow through)".

points.title: ～てくれと
points.formation: Verb-て form + くれと (言う / 頼む / 伝える, etc.)
points.shortExplanation: Quote someone's request (telling someone to do something).

points.title: ～てごらん
points.formation: Verb-て form + ごらん
points.shortExplanation: Suggest or invite someone to try doing something; 'Why don't you try...'.

points.title: ～てはじめて
points.formation: Verb-て form + はじめて
points.shortExplanation: Realization or action done for the first time; 'only after', 'not until'.

points.title: ～てほしい
points.formation: Verb-て form + ほしい
points.shortExplanation: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want you to do...'.

points.title: ～といいなあ
points.formation: Verb-casual + といいなあ, い-Adjective + といいなあ, な-Adjective + だといいなあ, Noun + だといいなあ
points.shortExplanation: Express a wish or hope; 'it would be nice if', 'I hope that'.

points.title: ～というと
points.formation: Noun + というと
points.shortExplanation: Used to provide an example or characteristic related to the topic; 'when it comes to', 'speaking of'.
points.usageNote: "Speaking of/when it comes to" - introduces a related example or characteristic.

points.title: ～というの～
points.formation: Verb-casual + というの, い-Adjective + というの, な-Adjective + だというの, Noun + だというの
points.shortExplanation: Explain or emphasize the reason for a situation or action.

points.title: ～というのは
points.formation: Phrase/sentence + というのは + explanation/definition
points.shortExplanation: Used to provide an explanation or definition; 'that is to say...', 'by that, I mean...'.

points.title: ～というより
points.formation: Verb-casual + というより, い-Adjective + というより, な-Adjective + だというより, Noun + だというより
points.shortExplanation: Express a comparison with preference; 'rather than', 'more like', 'instead of'.

points.title: ～とおり
points.formation: Verb-て form + とおり, Noun + のとおり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is done 'as is', 'as stated', or 'as instructed'.

points.title: ～とく
points.formation: Verb-て form + とく (e.g., 食べておく→食べとく, 読んでおく→読んどく)
points.shortExplanation: Express doing something in advance or for future convenience (casual form of ～ておく).

points.title: ～ところだった
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form or ている form) + ところだった
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a near miss or a situation that almost happened; 'was just about to', 'almost', 'nearly'.
points.usageNote: "Was just about to (but didn't)" - a near-miss, describes something that almost happened.

points.title: ～としたら
points.formation: Verb-casual + としたら, い-Adjective + としたら, な-Adjective + だとしたら, Noun + だとしたら
points.shortExplanation: Express a hypothetical situation; 'if', 'suppose', 'assuming'.
points.usageNote: The everyday hypothetical "assuming/if". (Near-duplicate of n2-098 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～として
points.formation: Verb-casual + として, い-Adjective + として, な-Adjective + だとして, Noun + だとして
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a role, capacity, or identity; 'as', 'in the capacity of'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "as/in the capacity of".

points.title: ～どんなに～ことか
points.formation: どんなに + Adjective + ことか, どんなに + Verb + ことか
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the extent of something or emphasizes the degree of a condition or situation.

points.title: ～ないことはない
points.formation: Verb-ない form + ことはない
points.shortExplanation: Express the idea that 'it's not that it's impossible' or 'it's not that it cannot be done'.
points.usageNote: "It's not impossible". (Near-duplicate of n2-102 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～ないと
points.formation: Verb-negative form + ないと
points.shortExplanation: Express a condition; 'if... not', 'unless', 'must'.
points.usageNote: Elliptical conditional idiom (～ないと(いけない) with the second half dropped) implying obligation - a distinct construction from the なければならない family, not just a different register of it. Deliberately excluded from the Obligation family: not a register variant, a different construction.

points.title: ～なんか
points.formation: Noun + なんか, Verb-casual + なんか, い-Adjective + なんか, な-Adjective + なんか
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'things like' or 'something like', used for listing examples or downplaying something.

points.title: ～において
points.formation: Noun (Place/Time/Context) + において
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the place, time, or context where an action or situation takes place.

points.title: ～にしては
points.formation: Verb-casual + にしては, い-Adjective + にしては, な-Adjective + にしては, Noun + にしては
points.shortExplanation: Express 'for' or 'considering' in the sense of being unusual or unexpected.
points.usageNote: "For/considering" - used when something is unusual or unexpected given X.

points.title: ～について
points.formation: Noun + について
points.shortExplanation: Expressing 'about', 'concerning', or 'regarding'.
points.usageNote: The everyday, standard "about/regarding".

points.title: ～にとって
points.formation: Noun (person or thing) + にとって + Verb/Adjective/Noun
points.shortExplanation: Express the meaning 'for', 'to', 'from the perspective of'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "for (someone)/from (someone)'s perspective".

points.title: ～によって
points.formation: Verb-casual + によって, い-Adjective + によって, な-Adjective + によって, Noun + によって
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason or cause, difference depending on a factor, or methods used.

points.title: ～によれば
points.formation: Noun + によれば
points.shortExplanation: Means 'according to', 'based on' or 'by'.
points.usageNote: The everyday way to cite a source - "according to...".

points.title: ～に対して
points.formation: Verb-casual + に対して, い-Adjective + に対して, な-Adjective + に対して, Noun + に対して
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a target or contrast; 'toward', 'against', 'in contrast to', 'in response to'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "toward/regarding" - also used for contrast between two things. (Near-duplicate of n2-123 - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～に比べて
points.formation: Verb-casual + に比べて, い-Adjective + に比べて, な-Adjective + だ/である + に比べて, Noun + だ/である + に比べて
points.shortExplanation: Comparing to; in comparison with; as opposed to.

points.title: ～に関して
points.formation: Noun + に関して
points.shortExplanation: Regarding, concerning, about, with respect to.

points.title: ～の～
