points.formation: Noun1 + の + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Indicates possession, attribution, or connection between two nouns.

points.title: ～ばかりか (〜bakarika) ～も
points.formation: Verb-casual + ばかりか/も, い-Adjective + ばかりか/も, な-Adjective + だ + ばかりか/も, Noun + だ + ばかりか/も
points.shortExplanation: Not only... but also; more than just; not just

points.title: ～ば～のに
points.formation: Verb-ば form + ～のに, い-Adjective-ば form + ～のに, な-Adjective + であれば + ～のに, Noun + であれば + ～のに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses regret or dissatisfaction; 'if only', 'wish'.
points.usageNote: Regretful - "if only X, (but reality is otherwise)".

points.title: ～ば～ほど
points.formation: Verb-casual + ば + Verb-casual + ほど, い-Adjective + ば + い-Adjective + ほど, な-Adjective + であれば + な-Adjective + ほど
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the more ~, the more ~'; a proportional relationship between two phrases.

points.title: ～はもちろん～も
points.formation: Noun1 + はもちろん + Noun2 + も
points.shortExplanation: Used for emphasizing that not only one thing but also another thing is included. It means 'not only... but also' or 'of course... and...'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "not only... but of course also".

points.title: ～ばよかった
points.formation: Verb-ば-form + よかった, い-Adjective-く + ばよかった, な-Adjective + ならよかった
points.shortExplanation: Express a sense of regret; 'I wish', 'it would have been better if'.

points.title: ～ふりをする
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ふりをする, い-Adjective + ふりをする, な-Adjective + ふりをする, Noun + ふりをする
points.shortExplanation: Pretending or acting as if; 'pretend', 'act like'.

points.title: ～べきだ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べきだ
points.shortExplanation: Express an obligation or something that should be done (mainly with verbs).

points.title: ～ほど～
points.formation: Verb-casual + ほど, い-Adjective + ほど, な-Adjective + ほど, Noun + ほど
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the degree or extent; 'about', 'to the extent', 'as much as'.
points.usageNote: "To the extent of/as much as" - a comparative degree marker, a distinct construction from くらい/ぐらい but the same approximate-degree idea.

points.title: ～ますように
points.formation: Verb-ます form, remove final る + ように
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a wish or hope for oneself or someone else.

points.title: まったく～ない
points.formation: まったく + Verb-negative, まったく + い-Adjective-negative, まったく + な-Adjective-negative
points.shortExplanation: Completely not; not at all.

points.title: ～まま
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + まま, い-Adjective + まま, な-Adjective + なまま, Noun + のまま
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the state or condition remaining unchanged.

points.title: まるで～よう
points.formation: まるで + phrase/sentence + よう
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a strong resemblance or similarity; 'as if', 'just like', 'as though'.
points.usageNote: Emphatic "just like/exactly as if" - まるで adds emphasis to an already-strong resemblance.

points.title: ～てみる
points.formation: Verb-て form + みる
points.shortExplanation: A grammar structure used to express the action of trying or attempting something to see what happens.

points.title: ～めったに～ない
points.formation: めったに + Verb[ない-form] / めったに + い-Adjective[ない-form] / めったに + な-Adjective[じゃない/ではない-form]
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that something rarely, hardly ever or seldom happens.

points.title: ～めったにない
points.formation: Verb-negative + めったにない, い-Adjective-negative + めったにない, な-Adjective-negative + めったにない, Noun-negative + めったにない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the rarity of an action, event or state; 'hardly', 'rarely', 'seldom'.

points.title: ～ようとしない
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + としない
points.shortExplanation: Not showing any sign or intention to do something.

points.title: ～ように
points.formation: Verb-casual + ように, い-Adjective + ように, な-Adjective + だように, Noun + のように
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a purpose, a way, or a natural tendency.

points.title: ～ようにしましょう
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ようにしましょう / Verb-negative form + ようにしましょう
points.shortExplanation: A suggestion to make an effort or try to do something; 'let's try to', 'let's make sure to'.

points.title: ～ようになった
points.formation: Verb-casual + ようになった
points.shortExplanation: Express an event or state that became possible; 'became able to', 'started to', 'now can'.

points.title: ～ように言う
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ように言う / Verb-nai form + ように言う
points.shortExplanation: To convey a message, instruction or request to someone; 'to tell (someone) to', 'to say to (someone)'.

points.title: ～られた
points.formation: Verb (passive form, past tense) + られた
points.shortExplanation: Express a passive action, 'was/were', 'has/have been'.

points.title: ～ている
points.formation: Verb-て form + いる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a continuing action or a resulting state; 'is ~ing', 'has been', 'has'.

points.title: ～わけがない
points.formation: Verb-casual + わけがない, い-Adjective + わけがない, な-Adjective + なわけがない, Noun + のわけがない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is impossible or unreasonable; 'there's no way', 'can't be'.
points.usageNote: "There's no way/it's impossible". (Near-duplicate of n2-162 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～わけだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + わけだ, い-Adjective + わけだ, な-Adjective + なわけだ, Noun + のわけだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a logical conclusion or reason based on information; 'that's why', 'no wonder', 'it means'.
points.usageNote: "It means/no wonder". (Near-duplicate of n2-163's わけだ - same word, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～わけではない
points.formation: Verb-casual + わけではない, い-Adjective + わけではない, な-Adjective + だわけではない, Noun + だわけではない
points.shortExplanation: Denies a general assumption; 'it does not mean that', 'it's not the case'.
points.usageNote: "It doesn't mean that/it's not the case that". (Near-duplicate of n2-164 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～わけにはいかない
points.formation: Verb-casual + わけにはいかない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something cannot be allowed or permitted due to social/moral obligations.
points.usageNote: "Cannot/must not do X". (Near-duplicate of n2-165 - same construction, taught at both N2 and N3.)

points.title: ～上げる
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + 上げる
points.shortExplanation: Indicates to finish doing something completely.

points.title: ～切れない
points.formation: Verb-stem + 切れない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses inability to completely finish or do something.

points.title: 必ずしも～とは限らない
points.formation: 必ずしも + Statement + とは限らない
points.shortExplanation: Not necessarily; not always.
points.usageNote: "Not always/not necessarily true" - with 必ずしも added up front for emphasis.

points.title: ～最中に
points.formation: Verb-て form + いる + 最中に, Noun + の + 最中に
points.shortExplanation: In the middle of / while doing something.

points.title: ～とおり
points.formation: Verb-casual + とおり, い-Adjective + とおり, な-Adjective + だとおり, Noun + だとおり
points.shortExplanation: Express doing something as instructed or describing how something matches a rule or guideline; 'as', 'according to'.
points.usageNote: "As/according to" - matches an instruction, plan, or expectation exactly.

points.title: ～にしたがって
points.formation: Noun + にしたがって
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a natural consequence or a change that occurs according to something else; 'as', 'with', 'in accordance with'.
points.usageNote: "As/with/in accordance with (a rule or guideline)".

points.title: ～以上
points.formation: Verb-casual + 以上, い-Adjective + 以上, な-Adjective + な以上, Noun + の以上
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'since' or 'as long as' in a conditional context.
points.usageNote: "Given that/since (this is the case), as long as it stands".

points.title: ～限り
points.formation: Verb-casual + 限り, い-Adjective + 限り, な-Adjective + な限り, Noun + の限り
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as long as', 'while', or 'to the extent that' a certain condition holds true.
points.usageNote: Neutral, common "as long as/to the extent that".

points.title: ～か～ないかのうちに
points.formation: Verb-casual + か + Verb-negative form + かのうちに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an action that occurs immediately after another action; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than', 'the moment'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "just as/almost before" - emphasizes the two actions nearly overlapping.

points.title: ～たかと思ったら
points.formation: Verb-た form + かと思ったら
points.shortExplanation: Express a sequence of events happening in quick succession; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, often carries surprise - "just when I thought..., then...".

points.title: ～次第
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第, Noun + 次第
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as soon as' (when used with Verb-ますstem) or 'depending on' (when used with a noun).
points.usageNote: "As soon as" with a ます-stem verb - a different construction from the others (also separately means "depending on" when attached to a noun).

points.title: ～ずにはいられない
points.formation: Verb-ない form (drop ない) + ずにはいられない
points.shortExplanation: Cannot help but; cannot resist doing; an irresistible urge.
points.usageNote: "Cannot resist doing/an irresistible urge" - the everyday version of the overwhelming-feeling idea.

points.title: ～ていられない
points.formation: Verb-て form + いられない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that one cannot afford to do something; 'can't keep on', 'unable to continue'.
points.usageNote: "Can't afford to keep doing X" - describes being unable to continue calmly given the situation.

points.title: ～でたまらない
points.formation: い-Adjective (く) + てたまらない / な-Adjective + でたまらない / Verb-て form + たまらない
points.shortExplanation: Express extremely strong feelings or sensations; 'can't stand', 'unbearably'.
points.usageNote: "Unbearably.../can't stand it" - an intense physical or emotional sensation.

points.title: ～でならない
points.formation: な-Adjective + でならない / い-Adjective (く) + てならない / Verb-て + ならない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an uncontrollable emotion or feeling; 'can’t help but', 'overwhelmingly'.
points.usageNote: "Can't help but feel.../overwhelmingly" - specifically for an uncontrollable emotion, not an action.

points.title: A。だって B。
points.formation: Verb-casual + だって、い-Adjective + だって、な-Adjective + だって、Noun + だって
points.shortExplanation: Used to give a reason, express cause or bring up a topic; 'because', 'since', 'it's just that'.
points.usageNote: Defensive/childish "because"; typically used to justify oneself, can sound whiny.

points.title: ～ばかりに
points.formation: Verb-casual + ばかりに, い-Adjective + ばかりに, な-Adjective + なばかりに, Noun + なばかりに
points.shortExplanation: Express an undesired situation or result caused by something; 'simply because', 'due to', 'on account of'.
points.usageNote: "Simply because of X, (an unfortunate result followed)" - always frames the cause as leading to a bad outcome.

points.title: ～ものだから
points.formation: Verb-plain + ものだから, い-Adjective + ものだから, な-Adjective + なものだから, Noun + なものだから
points.shortExplanation: Express the reason or cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.
points.usageNote: Explains/excuses a reason, often for something slightly unexpected; conversational but not blunt.

points.title: A。それなのに B。
points.formation: A。それなのに B。
points.shortExplanation: Express contrast or a contradiction between two situations or facts; 'even though', 'despite', 'but still'.
points.usageNote: Similar surprise/frustration nuance to ところが but stronger - often implies the speaker is annoyed or let down.

points.title: ～にもかかわらず
points.formation: Verb (any tense/form) + にもかかわらず, い-Adjective + にもかかわらず, な-Adjective (or Noun) + であるにもかかわらず
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'despite', 'in spite of' or 'even though'.
points.usageNote: Formal, neutral-toned "despite/in spite of"; safe in writing and polite speech, no built-in criticism.

points.title: ～に反して
points.formation: Noun + に反して
points.shortExplanation: Contrary to, against, in spite of
points.usageNote: Formal "contrary to (what was expected)" - the outcome defies the setup.

points.title: A。すると B。
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + と + Result
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that when action A is done, action or event B follows; 'then', 'when', 'if'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, everyday "then/if" - describes what naturally follows from an action.

points.title: ～からには
points.formation: Noun + だ + からには, な-Adjective + だ + からには, い-Adjective + からには, Verb-casual + からには
points.shortExplanation: Express a sense of responsibility or determination; 'since', 'now that', 'if'.
points.usageNote: "Now that/since (you've committed to X)" - implies a resulting obligation or determination.

points.title: ～上は
points.formation: Verb-casual + 上は, い-Adjective + 上は, な-Adjective + な上は, Noun + の上は
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'now that', 'since', or 'once'.
points.usageNote: "Now that.../since (this is decided)" - similar to からには, implies a resulting commitment.

points.title: A。それでも B。
points.formation: A (situation) + 。それでも + B (action or thought)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even so', 'nevertheless', 'still', or 'but'; used to contrast two statements.
points.usageNote: Stronger than a plain "but" - "even so/nevertheless"; used when the second clause defies what the first would lead you to expect.

points.title: A。ただB。
points.formation: Sentence A + ただ + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Express contrast between two situations; 'although', 'but', 'however'.
points.usageNote: Adds a minor reservation or exception to what was just said - "that said..."; softer than a full contrast.

points.title: A。ただしB。
points.formation: Statement A + ただし + Condition B
points.shortExplanation: Adding a condition or exception to a statement; 'however', 'provided that', 'but only if'.
points.usageNote: Formal - introduces a condition or exception to a rule just stated; common in contracts, regulations, instructions.

points.title: A。もっとも B。
points.formation: Clause A + もっとも + Clause B
points.shortExplanation: Express contrasting opinions or facts; 'although', 'but', 'however'.
points.usageNote: Concessive "though, to be fair..." - softens or qualifies a preceding statement rather than flatly contradicting it.

points.title: ～に応じて
points.formation: Noun + に応じて
points.shortExplanation: In accordance with, depending on, in response to.
points.usageNote: "Depending on/in accordance with" - adjusts based on a varying factor.

points.title: ～次第で
points.formation: Noun + 次第で
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'depending on; based on' a certain factor or situation.
points.usageNote: "Depending on X" - the outcome varies based on this factor.

points.title: ～次第です
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + 次第です (or Noun + 次第です)
points.shortExplanation: A polite/formal way to say 'it depends on...' or 'as soon as...', often used in concluding statements.
points.usageNote: Polite/formal "it depends on..." - often used in concluding formal statements.

points.title: ～てまで
points.formation: Verb-て form + まで
points.shortExplanation: Express the extent someone goes in order to achieve something; 'to the point of', 'even', 'so far as to'.
points.usageNote: Emphasizes going to an extreme extent - "even going so far as to...".

points.title: ～まで～て
points.formation: Time/Noun + まで + Verb(て-form)
points.shortExplanation: Express doing something until a certain time or condition; 'until', 'to'.
points.usageNote: Verb-て + まで variant - "(does something) until X happens".

points.title: ～にほかならない
points.formation: Verb-plain + にほかならない, い-Adjective + にほかならない, な-Adjective + にほかならない, Noun + にほかならない
points.shortExplanation: Express that something is 'nothing but' or 'none other than'.
points.usageNote: Emphatic literary "nothing other than" - asserts something is exactly and only this.

points.title: ～に過ぎない
points.formation: Verb-casual + に過ぎない, い-Adjective + に過ぎない, な-Adjective + に過ぎない, Noun + に過ぎない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is 'just' or 'nothing more than'; 'merely', 'only', 'simply'.
points.usageNote: Dismissive "merely/nothing more than" - downplays significance; common in writing and analysis.

points.title: ～に限り
points.formation: Noun + に限り
points.shortExplanation: Expresses limitation; 'only', 'limited to', 'exclusive to'.
points.usageNote: Administrative "limited to" - common in official rules, offers, terms.

points.title: ～ばかりだ
points.formation: Verb-てform + ばかりだ, い-Adjective + ばかりだ, な-Adjective + ばかりだ, Noun + ばかりだ
points.shortExplanation: Express a continuing state or negative tendency; 'just', 'only', 'always'.
points.usageNote: "Nothing but getting worse/only continuing to..." - describes a one-directional negative trend.

points.title: Noun にて
points.formation: Noun + にて
points.shortExplanation: Expresses location or means; 'at', 'in', 'by', 'with'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "at/in/by" - ceremonies, formal writing, old-fashioned register.

points.title: ～において
points.formation: Noun + において
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the place, time, or context where an action or event occurs; 'in', 'at', 'on', 'regarding'.
points.usageNote: Formal "in/at (a context)" - common in written and official language.

points.title: ～ざるを得ない
points.formation: Verb-ない form (drop ない) + ざるを得ない
points.shortExplanation: Have no choice but to; cannot help but.
points.usageNote: "Have no choice but to/cannot avoid doing" - the more common, less literary version of ざるを得ない.

points.title: ～よりほかない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + よりほかない
points.shortExplanation: Express that there is no other choice; 'have no choice but', 'cannot do anything but'.
points.usageNote: "Have no other choice but X" - names the one remaining option explicitly.

points.title: ～のみならず～も
points.formation: Verb-casual + のみならず + (も), い-Adjective + のみならず + (も), な-Adjective + のみならず + (も), Noun + のみならず + (も)
points.shortExplanation: Not only... but also; as well as.
points.usageNote: "Not only... but also" - formal, written register.

points.title: ～ばかりか〜も
points.formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + ばかりか + Noun/Verb/Adjective + も
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not only... but also'; emphasizing the extent of something.
points.usageNote: "Not only... but even" - emphasizes the second, often surprising, fact.

points.title: ～にあたり
points.formation: Noun + にあたり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'at the time of', 'in', 'on', or 'upon'.
points.usageNote: Formal "at the time of/in undertaking X" - formal announcements, ceremonies.
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: ～に際して
points.formation: Noun + に際して
points.shortExplanation: Used to express the moment or the occasion of an action; 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when'.
points.usageNote: Formal "on the occasion of/at the time of" - common in speeches, formal announcements.
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: ～折には
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 折には, Verb-た form + 折には, い-Adjective + 折には, な-Adjective + な折には, Noun + の折には
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'when' or 'in case of' specific situations or timings.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary, ceremonial "on the occasion of". (Near-duplicate of n1-240's 折に, with は added.)
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: ～際に
points.formation: Verb-casual + 際に, い-Adjective + 際に, な-Adjective + な際に, Noun + の際に
points.shortExplanation: Means 'when', 'while', or 'on the occasion of' a certain event or situation.
points.usageNote: Neutral, the everyday marker for an occasion or event - "on the occasion of/when".
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: ～から見ると
points.formation: Noun + から見ると
points.shortExplanation: Express a perspective or point of view; 'from the standpoint of', 'in terms of', 'from the perspective of'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "from the standpoint of/looking at it from...".

points.title: ～から言うと
points.formation: Noun + から言うと (common), [Verb-casual / Adjective + から言って] (less common)
points.shortExplanation: Express a judgment or opinion based on a specific criterion; 'speaking from', 'in terms of', 'from the viewpoint of'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "speaking from.../judging by...".

points.title: ～にしたら
points.formation: Noun + にしたら, Pronoun + にしたら
points.shortExplanation: Express a point of view; 'from the perspective of', 'if I were'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "if you ask.../from (someone)'s perspective" - often used for a third party's viewpoint.

points.title: 〜の上では
points.formation: Noun or Phrase + の上では
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'on the basis of', 'in terms of', or 'from the standpoint of'.
points.usageNote: Formal "on the basis of/in terms of" - typically for a formal/technical criterion (e.g. "legally speaking").

points.title: ～につれて
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + につれて, Noun + につれて
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that as one thing changes, so does another; 'as', 'along with', 'while'.
points.usageNote: "As X changes, so does Y" - describes two related changes happening together.

points.title: ～にともなって
points.formation: Noun (event) + にともなって, Verb-casual + にともなって
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'along with' or 'as a result of'; indicates that one event occurs along with another.
points.usageNote: "Along with/as a result of" - similar proportional-change sense to につれて, slightly more formal.

points.title: Noun につき
points.formation: Noun + につき
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason, cause, or condition for something; 'due to', 'regarding', 'per'.
points.usageNote: Official "regarding/per" - notices, announcements, official documents.

points.title: Noun を めぐる Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + を + めぐる + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Indicate a situation or event revolving around a particular noun; 'concerning', 'regarding', 'pertaining to'.
points.usageNote: "Revolving around/concerning" - typically a debate, dispute, or complex topic.

points.title: ～に関わって
points.formation: Verb-casual + に関わって, い-Adjective + に関わって, な-Adjective + に関わって, Noun + に関わって
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is related to or influenced by a certain matter or factor; 'concerning', 'in connection with', 'regarding'.
points.usageNote: "In connection with/concerning".

points.title: A あるいは B
points.formation: Phrase A + あるいは + Phrase B
points.shortExplanation: Indicates alternatives; 'A or B', 'either A or B'.
points.usageNote: Neutral, plain "or" - the everyday conjunction, not the literary A-とも-B-とも pattern.

points.title: ～にしろ～にしろ
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form or negative form) + にしろ, い-Adjective + にしろ, な-Adjective + にしろ, Noun + にしろ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'either way', 'in any case', 'be it...', used when presenting two alternatives.
points.usageNote: Neutral "either way/in any case" - the everyday version of the whether-A-or-B pattern, less literary than the N1 forms.

points.title: ～にかかわらず
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + にかかわらず, い-Adjective + にかかわらず, な-Adjective + にかかわらず, Noun + にかかわらず
points.shortExplanation: Regardless of; irrespective of; (often used as) 'whether or not'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "regardless of/irrespective of" - the everyday version, less formal than the N1 forms.

points.title: ～を問わず
points.formation: Noun + を問わず
points.shortExplanation: Means 'regardless of' or 'irrespective of'.
points.usageNote: Formal "regardless of/irrespective of" - common in official contexts (e.g. job postings: "regardless of experience").

points.title: A すなわち B。
points.formation: Phrase A + すなわち + Phrase B
points.shortExplanation: Express that A is equivalent to B; 'in other words', 'namely', 'that is to say'.
points.usageNote: Very formal, literary "namely/that is" - legal, academic, or formal writing.

points.title: A。というのは B。
points.formation: [Statement A]。というのは、[Statement B]。
points.shortExplanation: Used to give an explanation or provide additional information for A; 'that is to say', 'in other words'.
points.usageNote: "The reason is/what I mean is" - explains or clarifies what was just said.

points.title: ～かねない
points.formation: Verb-stem + かねない
points.shortExplanation: Express the likelihood of a negative outcome or consequence.
points.usageNote: "Might result in (a negative outcome)" - a warning about a possible bad consequence.

points.title: ～恐れがある
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 恐れがある
points.shortExplanation: Express a concern or fear that something undesirable might occur.
points.usageNote: Formal "there is a risk/concern that..." - written, cautionary register.

points.title: ～あげく
points.formation: Verb-た + あげく / Noun + の + あげく
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the outcome of a series of actions or events; 'in the end', 'finally', 'after'.
points.usageNote: Often a negative outcome - "after all that, (unfortunately)...".

points.title: ～たきり
points.formation: Verb-past + きり
points.shortExplanation: Express 'since then' or 'after'; used to indicate that an action occurred once and has not been repeated or that a state has continued since a certain event or time.
points.usageNote: "Since then, X hasn't happened again" - marks a one-time event with no follow-up.

points.title: ～上で
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + 上で, Noun + の上で
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that something is done after or on the basis of something else; 'after', 'upon'.
points.usageNote: "After doing X, on that basis" - the next step builds on the first.

points.title: Noun を はじめ
points.formation: Noun + をはじめ
points.shortExplanation: Meaning 'starting with', 'including', 'not only... but also'.
points.usageNote: The common, everyday "starting with/including".

points.title: Noun を はじめとして
points.formation: Noun + をはじめとして
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'starting with', 'beginning with', or 'including'.
points.usageNote: The common, everyday "starting with/including". (Grammatical variant of n2-029's をはじめ.)

points.title: Noun を はじめとする Noun
points.romaji: Noun o hajime to suru Noun
points.formation: Noun1 を はじめとする Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a representative example of a group; 'starting with', 'including', 'such as'.
points.usageNote: The common, everyday "starting with/including", attributive form modifying a following noun. (Grammatical variant of n2-029's をはじめ.)

points.title: A。したがって B。
points.formation: A + したがって + B
points.shortExplanation: Express a cause-and-effect relationship; 'therefore', 'consequently', 'so'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "therefore/consequently" - written, academic, or formal speech.

points.title: A。そこで B。
points.formation: A + そこで + B
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'therefore' or 'because of that'.
points.usageNote: "So, at that point" - narrative, marks the next logical step in a story.

points.title: ～により
points.formation: Noun + により, Verb + により
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the reason, method, or means by which something happens; 'by', 'through', 'due to'.
points.usageNote: Formal "by means of/due to" - method or cause, common in formal/written contexts.

points.title: ～にわたって
points.formation: Noun + にわたって
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a range or extent; 'over', 'throughout', 'across'.
points.usageNote: Formal "over/across (a range)" - typically time or scope.

points.title: ～を通じて
points.formation: Noun + を通じて
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'through', 'throughout', or 'during'.
points.usageNote: Formal "through/throughout" - a channel or period something happens via/across.

points.title: A。さて B。
points.formation: A + さて + B
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a sudden change or shift in the topic or situation; 'now then', 'well', 'so'.
points.usageNote: "Well then/now" - a deliberate shift to a new topic or phase.

points.title: A。そういえば B。
points.formation: A + そういえば + B
points.shortExplanation: Recalling something related to A; 'speaking of which', 'by the way', 'now that you mention it'.
points.usageNote: Casual "speaking of which" - triggered by something reminding the speaker of a related topic.

points.title: A それはそうと B。
points.romaji: A Sore wa sou to B
points.formation: Sentence A + それはそうと + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Changing the topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of which'.
points.usageNote: "By the way" as a deliberate topic change.

points.title: A。ちなみに B。
points.formation: A。ちなみに B。
points.shortExplanation: Used to give additional information about the topic; 'by the way', 'incidentally'.
points.usageNote: Formal-leaning "incidentally" - adds a related side note, common in writing too.

points.title: ～そうにない
points.formation: Verb-stem + そうにない / い-Adjective (drop い) + そうにない / な-Adjective + そうにない
points.shortExplanation: Express the unlikelihood of something happening; 'not likely', 'doesn't seem'.
points.usageNote: "Doesn't seem likely to happen". (Near-duplicate of n1-122 - same construction, taught at both N1 and N2.)

points.title: ～っこない
points.formation: Verb-negative stem + っこない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the impossibility or very low probability of something happening; 'no way', 'impossible'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken "no way/impossible" - blunt, conversational.

points.title: ～ものか
points.formation: Verb-casual + ものか, い-Adjective + ものか, な-Adjective + (な)ものか, Noun + (な)ものか
points.shortExplanation: Definitely not; no way; no chance.
points.usageNote: Rhetorical "no way/definitely not" - a strong denial phrased as a question.

points.title: ～ようがない
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + ようがない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that there is no way (method) to do something; it's impossible to do.
points.usageNote: "There's no way to do X". (Near-duplicate of n1-150 - same construction, taught at both N1 and N2.)

points.title: ～さえ～ば
points.formation: Noun + さえ + Verb-conditional / Verb-ますstem + さえすれば / etc. (varies by part of speech)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that, as long as a certain condition is met, something else will follow; 'if only', 'provided that'.
points.usageNote: "If only X, then Y would follow" - a conditional wish, not necessarily regretful.

points.title: ～ものなら
points.formation: Verb-(potential/plain) form + ものなら, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a conditional wish or unlikely possibility; 'if only', 'if it were possible'.
points.usageNote: A wishful, often unlikely conditional - "if only it were possible to...".

points.title: A。それがB。
points.formation: A (Statement)。それが B (Restatement or explanation of A)。
points.shortExplanation: Expressing 'that's exactly what A is; in other words, B'.

points.title: A。それなら B。
points.formation: Situation A (sentence) + 。それなら + Situation B (sentence)
points.shortExplanation: Express 'if that's the case, then'; used to show a logical consequence or decision based on a given situation.

points.title: A。ということは B。
points.romaji: A. To iu koto wa B.
points.formation: A + ということは + B
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning 'if A, that means B' or 'A implies B'.

points.title: A。要するに B。
points.formation: A。要するに B。
points.shortExplanation: Expressing 'in short', 'in a nutshell', or 'to sum up' when restating or summarizing A as B.

points.title: Noun の ことだから
points.formation: Noun + のことだから
points.shortExplanation: Used to provide a reason or explanation based on one's knowledge about the noun; 'since', 'because', 'knowing'.

points.title: Noun を めぐって
points.formation: Noun + を + めぐって
points.shortExplanation: Concerning; with regard to; about

points.title: Noun を もとに
points.formation: Noun + をもとに
points.shortExplanation: Based on; drawing from; using as a reference.

points.title: Noun を もとにして
points.formation: Noun + をもとにして
points.shortExplanation: Based on; using; utilizing.

points.title: Verb ことなく
points.formation: Verb-stem + ことなく
points.shortExplanation: Means 'without doing', 'not doing', or 'without happening'.

points.title: Verb ないことには Verb ない
points.formation: Verb-ない + ことには + Verb-ない
points.shortExplanation: Express that something cannot be done without meeting a certain condition.

points.title: ～あまり
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + あまり, い-Adjective + あまり, な-Adjective + のあまり, Noun + のあまり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the result of doing something excessively or beyond a certain point.

points.title: ～がい
points.formation: Verb-stem + がい
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'worth doing' for verbs.

points.title: ～かいがあって
points.formation: Verb-past + かいがあって / Noun + の + かいがあって
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that an effort is worth it or has value; 'to be worth the effort' or 'to pay off'.

points.title: ～かいもなく
points.formation: Verb-た + かいもなく / Noun + の + かいもなく
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'without worth', 'in vain', 'fruitless'.

points.title: ～かける
points.formation: Verb-stem + かける
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a process or action is 'in progress' or 'halfway'.

points.title: ～がち
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + がち / い-Adjective stem + がち / な-Adjective stem + がち
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something tends to occur frequently or habitually.

points.title: ～かねる
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + かねる
points.shortExplanation: Express inability or impossibility of doing an action (often as a polite refusal).

points.title: ～か～まいか
points.formation: Verb-volitional + か + Verb-volitional + まいか, い-Adjective + であるか + い-Adjective + であるまいか, な-Adjective + であるか + な-Adjective + であるまいか, Noun + であるか + Noun + であるまいか
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a dilemma or indecision between two options or actions.
points.usageNote: "Whether to do X or not" - the everyday version of the indecision pattern.

points.title: ～からこそ
points.formation: Verb-casual + からこそ, い-Adjective + からこそ, な-Adjective + だからこそ, Noun + だからこそ
points.shortExplanation: Express the emphasis on the reason; 'precisely because', 'it is precisely because'.

points.title: 〜からして
points.formation: Noun + からして
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is exceptional, unusual, or negative based on a particular aspect or point.

points.title: ～からすると
points.formation: Noun + からすると
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a judgment or evaluation based on a certain standard; 'from this perspective', 'considering', 'judging from'.
points.usageNote: "From this perspective/judging from".

points.title: ～からといって
points.formation: Verb-casual + からといって, い-Adjective + からといって, な-Adjective + だからといって, Noun + だからといって
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'just because...doesn't mean' or 'even though...not necessarily'.

points.title: ～くせに
points.formation: Verb (casual) + くせに / い-Adjective + くせに / な-Adjective + な(or の) + くせに / Noun + の + くせに
points.shortExplanation: Used to criticize someone for doing something contrary to what one would expect from their nature or situation.

points.title: ～ことに
points.formation: Verb-casual + ことに / い-Adjective + ことに / な-Adjective + なことに / Noun + のことに
points.shortExplanation: Used to express feelings or emotions about a situation, action, or outcome.

points.title: ～ことになっている
points.formation: Verb-plain form + ことになっている / い-Adjective + ことになっている / な-Adjective + だ + ことになっている / Noun + だ + ことになっている
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is supposed to be or has been decided (rule, plan, custom).

points.title: ～だけあって
points.formation: Verb-casual + だけあって, い-Adjective + だけあって, な-Adjective + なだけあって, Noun + だけあって
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is as expected or deserves its reputation.

points.title: ～だけましだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + だけましだ, い-Adjective + だけましだ, な-Adjective + だけましだ, Noun + だけましだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that although the situation isn’t ideal, it could be worse; 'it’s not great, but at least...'.

points.title: ～たところ
points.formation: Verb-past + ところ
points.shortExplanation: Used to describe an action that has just been completed, often followed by a result or observation.

points.title: ～だらけ
points.formation: Noun + だらけ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is full of or covered with a certain (usually negative) characteristic.

points.title: ～つつある
points.formation: Verb-stem + つつある
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an ongoing process or gradual change.

points.title: ～っぱなし
points.formation: Verb-ます stem + っぱなし
points.shortExplanation: Express a continuous action or state; 'left as is', 'non-stop'.

points.title: ～っぽい
points.formation: Noun + っぽい, Verb-casual + っぽい, い-Adjective + っぽい, な-Adjective + っぽい
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something has the appearance, characteristics, or behavior of something else.

points.title: ～てかなわない
points.formation: Adjective (〜く / 〜で) + て + かなわない / Verb phrase (reworded to an adjective/negative) + て + かなわない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something cannot be endured, tolerated, or is unbearable.

points.title: ～てからでないと
points.formation: Verb-て + からでないと
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something cannot be done before a certain action is completed; 'not until', 'only after'.

points.title: ～てこそ
points.formation: Verb-て form + こそ / い-Adjective + くてこそ / な-Adjective + でこそ / Noun + でこそ
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the condition; 'only when', 'precisely because'.

points.title: ～でしょうがない
points.formation: い-Adjective(く) + てしょうがない / な-Adjective + で(は)しょうがない / Verb-て form + しょうがない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an intense emotional or physical state; 'extremely', 'can’t help but'.
points.usageNote: Casual, spoken "unbearably/can't help but" - the everyday way to express an intense feeling.

points.title: ～でばかりはいられない
points.formation: Verb-て form + ばかりはいられない / Noun + ばかりはいられない (with appropriate particles)
points.shortExplanation: Cannot afford to only do something; cannot always rely on it.

points.title: ～ではないか
points.formation: Noun + ではないか / い-Adjective + ではないか / な-Adjective + ではないか / Verb-casual + ではないか
points.shortExplanation: Used to show a strong assertion or emphasis on one’s opinion; 'isn't it?', 'aren't you?', 'right?'.

points.title: ～て当然だ
points.formation: Verb-て form + 当然だ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is natural or expected.

points.title: ～というものだ
points.formation: Sentence + というものだ
points.shortExplanation: Expressing a general rule or common sense.

points.title: どうにか～ないものか
points.romaji: dō ni ka ~ nai mono ka
points.formation: どうにか + Verb-negative form + ないものか
points.shortExplanation: Express a strong desire or wish for something to be possible.

points.title: ～ところ
points.formation: Verb-casual + ところ, い-Adjective + ところ, な-Adjective + なところ, Noun + のところ
points.shortExplanation: Express a specific point in time or state; 'when', 'just about', or 'in the middle of'.
points.usageNote: "Right at this point/just about to" - flexible, can mark just-before, during, or just-after a moment.

points.title: ～どころか
points.formation: Verb-casual + どころか, い-Adjective + どころか, な-Adjective + どころか, Noun + どころか
points.shortExplanation: Express 'far from', 'not just', 'not only', or 'to say nothing of'.
points.usageNote: Stronger contrast - "far from it, actually..." - often flips the expected direction entirely.

points.title: ～どころではない
points.formation: Verb-casual + どころではない, い-Adjective + どころではない, な-Adjective + どころではない, Noun + どころではない
points.shortExplanation: Not the time/place for; far from; can't possibly.

points.title: ～としても
points.formation: Verb-casual + としても, い-Adjective + としても, な-Adjective + だとしても, Noun + だとしても
points.shortExplanation: Even if, despite, although

points.title: ～と～ともに
points.formation: Verb-casual + とともに, い-Adjective + とともに, な-Adjective + とともに, Noun + とともに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'together with' or 'along with'; used to describe two events or actions happening simultaneously or in parallel.
points.usageNote: "Together with" - two things happening in parallel.

points.title: ～とは限らない
points.formation: Verb-casual + とは限らない, い-Adjective + とは限らない, な-Adjective + だとは限らない, Noun + だとは限らない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is not necessarily true; 'not always', 'not necessarily'.
points.usageNote: "Not always/not necessarily true" - the everyday hedge against a generalization.

points.title: ～ないこともない
points.formation: Verb-ないForm + こともない, い-adjective + こともない
points.shortExplanation: Used to express an action or state is 'not impossible', but emphasizes reluctance or doubt.
points.usageNote: "It's not impossible, but..." - emphasizes reluctance more than n2-102.

points.title: ～ながら
points.formation: Verb-stem + ながら
points.shortExplanation: Express doing two things simultaneously or at the same time.

points.title: ～にかけては
points.formation: Noun + にかけては
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a specific area or aspect in which someone or something excels.

points.title: ～につけ～につけ
points.formation: Verb-casual + につけ, い-Adjective + につけ, な-Adjective + につけ, Noun + につけ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whenever', 'each time', 'whether...or'.
points.usageNote: "Whether...or, in either case" - pairs two contrasting occasions.

points.title: ～に先立ち
points.formation: Noun + に先立ち / Verb-dictionary form + に先立って
points.shortExplanation: Express an action or event that occurs before another; 'before', 'prior to', 'preceding'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "prior to" - similar register to に先駆けて, common in formal announcements.

points.title: ～に基づいて
points.formation: Noun + に基づいて
points.shortExplanation: Based on, according to, depending on
points.usageNote: Formal "based on/according to" - policy, rules, or established facts, common in writing.

points.title: ～に応えて
points.formation: Noun + に応えて
points.shortExplanation: Responding to; living up to; meeting.

points.title: ～に決まっている
points.formation: Verb-casual + に決まっている, い-Adjective + に決まっている, な-Adjective + だに決まっている, Noun + だに決まっている
points.shortExplanation: Express certainty; 'it is obvious', 'it must be', 'no doubt'.

points.title: ～に沿って
points.formation: Noun + に沿って
points.shortExplanation: Along with; in accordance with; following

points.title: ～のももっともだ
points.formation: Verb-casual + のももっともだ, い-Adjective + のももっともだ, な-Adjective + なのももっともだ, Noun + なのももっともだ
points.shortExplanation: Express that something is understandable or reasonable.

points.title: ～の下で
points.formation: Verb-casual + の下で, い-Adjective + の下で, な-Adjective + の下で, Noun + の下で
points.shortExplanation: Under the context or condition of; under.

points.title: ～ば～というものでもない
points.formation: Verb-ば form + というものでもない
points.shortExplanation: Not necessarily true that if A, then B.

points.title: ～はともかく～は
points.formation: Noun1 はともかく Noun2 は
points.shortExplanation: Used to compare or contrast two elements; 'as for...'.

points.title: ～はまだしも
points.formation: Noun1 + はまだしも + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that while the first item is somewhat acceptable, the second item is not.

points.title: ～はもとより
points.formation: Noun1 + はもとより, Noun2 + も
points.shortExplanation: Expressing that something is obvious, and there is also something else.

points.title: ～は抜きにして
points.formation: Noun + は抜きにして
points.shortExplanation: Leaving aside, excluding.

points.title: ～まい
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + まい
points.shortExplanation: Express a negative conjecture or determination; 'probably not' or 'I will not'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary negative conjecture - "probably not/I won't" - the negative counterpart to だろう.

points.title: ～ままに
points.formation: Verb-て + まま, い-Adjective + のまま, な-Adjective + なまま, Noun + のまま
points.shortExplanation: Act according to; leave as is; unchanged.

points.title: ～もかまわず
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + もかまわず, Noun + もかまわず
points.shortExplanation: Express indifference or disregard; 'without hesitating', 'without worrying about'.

points.title: ～ものがある
points.formation: Verb-casual + ものがある, い-Adjective + ものがある, な-Adjective + なものがある
points.shortExplanation: Express a strong impression or feeling; 'there's something about it that...'

points.title: ～ものだ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものだ, な-Adjective + なものだ, (Also: Verb-た form + ものだ for recollections)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses something natural or expected; 'it is normal that...', 'should', 'ought to'.
points.usageNote: Moralizing "that's just how things are/should be" - general truths or social norms.

points.title: ～ものではない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものではない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a strong negative suggestion or prohibition: 'should not', 'must not'.
points.usageNote: A social/moral prohibition - "that's not the sort of thing one does" - rather than a hard rule.

points.title: ～も～ば～も～
points.formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + も + (Verb/Adjective in ば-form) + も + (Verb/Adjective)
points.shortExplanation: Lists multiple attributes or actions applying to the same subject: 'both…and…', 'not only…but also…'.

points.title: ～も同然だ
points.formation: Noun + (も)同然だ, Verb-casual + (も)同然だ, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'as good as', 'virtually', or 'practically' the same as something.

points.title: ～やら～やら
points.formation: Verb-casual + やら, い-Adjective + やら, な-Adjective + やら, Noun + やら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses various items or actions, 'things like..., and so on'.

points.title: ～をきっかけに
points.formation: Noun + をきっかけに
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something serves as a trigger or starting point for another action/event.

points.title: ～を～として
points.formation: Noun1 + を + Noun2 + として
points.shortExplanation: Express 'as', 'in the capacity of', or 'taking something as...'.
points.usageNote: The everyday "as/in the capacity of", with を explicitly marking the treated-as object.

points.title: ～を中心に
points.formation: Noun + を中心に
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is centered around or focused on a main topic or area.

points.title: ～を込めて
points.formation: Feeling/emotion/intention Noun + を + 込めて + Verb
points.shortExplanation: To express that something is done with a certain feeling, intention, or emotion.

points.title: ～を頼りに
points.formation: Noun + を頼りに
points.shortExplanation: To rely on or depend on something or someone.

points.title: ～一方
points.formation: Verb-casual + 一方(で), い-Adjective + 一方(で), な-Adjective + な/である一方(で), Noun + である一方(で)
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that while one action or situation is happening, another action or situation is also occurring or is in contrast.

points.title: ～一方だ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 一方だ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that a situation or condition is continuing to increase or decrease in one direction.

points.title: ～上に
points.formation: Verb-plain + 上に, い-Adjective + 上に, な-Adjective + な上に, Noun + の上に
points.shortExplanation: Express 'in addition to', 'besides', 'not only... but also'.
points.usageNote: Neutral "in addition to" - pairs two related facts/qualities.

points.title: ～切る
points.formation: Verb-stem + 切る
points.shortExplanation: To do something completely or thoroughly.

points.title: ～反面
points.formation: Verb-casual + 反面, い-Adjective + 反面, な-Adjective + である反面, Noun + である反面
points.shortExplanation: Express contrast between two aspects; 'on the one hand', 'on the other hand'.

points.title: ～向け
points.formation: Noun + 向け
points.shortExplanation: Indicating target or intended audience.

points.title: ～気味
points.formation: Noun + 気味 (e.g., 風邪気味, 寝不足気味, 緊張気味)
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a slight feeling or tendency toward a particular state.

points.title: Verb たが最後
points.formation: Verb-casual, past (た form) + が最後
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes 'once something happens, there is no going back'; 'once', 'as soon as', etc.
points.usageNote: Very formal, literary - "once X happens, there's no going back"; emphasizes irreversibility, not just timing.

points.title: Verb たら最後
points.formation: Verb-た form + ら最後
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that once a certain action happens, the situation changes irreversibly—usually in a negative way.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "once X happens, there's no going back (usually badly)" - near-synonym of n1-125's たが最後.

points.title: Verbる なり
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + なり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as soon as' or 'the moment'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "the moment X, immediately Y" - written narrative style.

points.title: Verbる や否や
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + や否や
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'as soon as', 'the moment...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "no sooner than" - written narrative style.

points.title: Noun に即した Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + に即した + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'in accordance with', 'based on'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "in accordance with/based on" - policy, rules, or established facts.

points.title: Noun に即して Verb
points.formation: Noun + に即して + Verb
points.shortExplanation: The grammar point Noun に即して Verb is used to mean 'to act in accordance with', 'in line with' or 'based on'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "in accordance with/based on". (Verb-attached form of n1-066's に即した.)

points.title: Noun を前提として
points.formation: Noun + を前提として
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'on the assumption of', 'based on'.
points.usageNote: Formal "on the assumption/premise of" - written, argumentative, or planning contexts.

points.title: Verb ずにはすまない
points.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずにはすまない
points.shortExplanation: 'Cannot do without...', 'unavoidable', 'have to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot get away without doing X/is unavoidable".

points.title: Verb てやまない
points.formation: Verb-て form + やまない (common with certain verbs)
points.shortExplanation: Used with certain emotional/mental verbs to show a strong, unceasing emotion: 'can't stop', 'never cease to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "never cease to..." - a strong, unceasing emotion, used with a narrow set of verbs (hope, love, wish).

points.title: ～がゆえに
points.formation: Noun / Verb / Adjective + がゆえに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the reason or cause; 'because', 'due to', 'as a result of'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary/academic; emphasizes logical cause-and-effect. Rare in speech.

points.title: ～がゆえの Noun
points.formation: Noun / Verb-dictionary form + がゆえの + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the reason or cause for something; 'because of', 'due to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary; noun-modifying form of がゆえに.

points.title: ～こととて
points.formation: Verb (plain form) + こととて / Noun + の + こととて / (な-Adjective + な) + こととて
points.shortExplanation: Used to express the reason or premise for a decision or judgment; 'since', 'because'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary; specifically apologizes for or excuses an outcome as unavoidable given the circumstances - politely deflects blame, distinct from がゆえに's more neutral logical framing.

points.title: Noun にして
points.formation: Noun + にして
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea 'even for', 'even though', or 'in spite of'.
points.usageNote: Literary "even for/even at (a point that would normally be enough)"; narrow, high-register usage.

points.title: ～といえども
points.formation: Noun + といえども / Verb-plain form + といえども / Adjective + といえども
points.shortExplanation: Even if it is said that; Even though; Although.
points.usageNote: Very formal, literary "even though/even if" - classical register.

points.title: ～とはいえ
points.formation: Noun + とはいえ, な-Adjective + だとはいえ, い-Adjective + とはいえ, Verb-casual + とはいえ
points.shortExplanation: Even though; although; but
points.usageNote: Formal "even though/that said" - softens a preceding statement with a caveat.

points.title: ～ながらも
points.formation: Verb stem + ながらも, い-Adjective + ながらも, な-Adjective/Noun + ながらも
points.shortExplanation: Means 'even though' or 'despite'.
points.usageNote: Literary "even though/despite", pairs a state with a contrasting action taken anyway; more literary than にもかかわらず.

points.title: Noun ともなれば
points.formation: Noun + ともなれば
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'if it comes to', 'when', or 'once'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "once it reaches the point of/when it comes to".

points.title: ～とあれば
points.formation: Verb-casual + とあれば / い-Adjective + とあれば / な-Adjective + だとあれば / Noun + だとあれば
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a condition; 'if', 'when', 'since'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "if it comes to/should the case arise".

points.title: ～とすると
points.formation: Verb-casual + とすると / い-Adjective + とすると / な-Adjective + だとすると / Noun + だとすると
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'if', 'when', or 'assuming that' in a speculative sense.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "assuming that/if we suppose" - speculative register.

points.title: Noun たりとも～ない
points.formation: Noun + たりとも + Negative Verb
points.shortExplanation: Used to show a strong negative: 'not even ~', 'not a single ~'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not even a single..." - absolute negation, emphatic.

points.title: Noun ですら
points.formation: Noun + ですら
points.shortExplanation: Means 'even', 'as much as', used for emphasis in formal contexts.
points.usageNote: Formal emphasis "even" - written/formal register, used for a striking example.

points.title: Noun にすら
points.formation: Noun + にすら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'even'; 'even in', 'even as', 'even to'.
points.usageNote: Formal emphasis "even" - a variant of ですら for a different grammatical slot.

points.title: Noun にもまして
points.formation: Noun + にもまして
points.shortExplanation: This expresses 'Even more than; exceeding'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "even more than X" - comparative emphasis.

points.title: Verb ないまでも
points.formation: Verb-ない form + までも
points.shortExplanation: 'Even if not to the extent of...', 'although not completely...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "even if not fully X, at least..." - a partial concession.

points.title: ～としたところで
points.formation: Verb-casual + としたところで / い-Adjective + としたところで / な-Adjective + だとしたところで / Noun + だとしたところで
points.shortExplanation: Means 'even if' or 'even assuming'; emphasizes that the outcome won’t change.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - "even granting X, the outcome wouldn't change".

points.title: ～といったらありはしない
points.formation: Noun + といったらありはしない / な-Adjective + といったらありはしない
points.shortExplanation: Express extreme exclamation; 'extremely', 'unbelievable', 'unsurpassed'.
points.usageNote: Very formal, literary exclamation - "extremely, beyond words"; dramatic, rare in casual speech.

points.title: ～極まりない
points.formation: な-Adjective（語幹）+ 極まりない, い-Adjective（連用形）+ こと + 極まりない, Noun + の極まりない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an extreme state, often negative; 'utterly', 'extremely', 'boundlessly'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "utterly/extremely" - often for a negative extreme state.

points.title: Noun をもって
points.formation: Noun + をもって
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate means, methods, or time; 'with', 'by means of', 'at'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "by means of/as of" - official announcements, deadlines.

points.title: Noun を限りに
points.formation: Noun + を限りに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'as of', 'with', or 'from', indicating the end of something or a point of change.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "as of (this point), marking an end" - announcements of a conclusion/cutoff.

points.title: Noun を禁じ得ない
points.formation: Noun + を禁じ得ない
points.shortExplanation: 'Cannot help but do', or 'inevitable'
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot help feeling..." - specifically for an emotional reaction one cannot suppress.

points.title: Verb ざるを得ない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ざるを得ない (する → せざるを得ない)
points.shortExplanation: 'Cannot but', 'have no choice but to', 'forced to'
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "have no choice but to/cannot avoid doing" - circumstances leave no alternative.

points.title: Verb ずにはおかない
points.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずにはおかない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'cannot help but...', 'will definitely...', or 'must do something'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "will inevitably.../is bound to" - emphasizes an unavoidable natural consequence.

points.title: Verb ないではすまない
points.formation: Verb-ない form + ではすまない
points.shortExplanation: 'Cannot end without doing', 'must do'—an unavoidable moral or social necessity.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "cannot end without doing/is a moral obligation" - a social/moral necessity, not just circumstance.

points.title: ～とのことだ
points.formation: Simplified phrase + とのことだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses something that the speaker heard; 'I've heard that', 'I was told that'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary hearsay - "I was told that/it is said that".

points.title: ～とみえて
points.formation: Verb-casual + とみえて, い-Adjective + とみえて, な-Adjective + だとみえて, Noun + だとみえて
points.shortExplanation: It seems that; apparently
points.usageNote: Formal, literary observational inference - "it appears that (judging from what I see)".

points.title: Verbる にはあたらない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + にはあたらない
points.shortExplanation: Used to say 'there is no need to...', 'it’s not necessary to...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "there's no need to/it's not necessary to".

points.title: Verbる までもない
points.formation: Verb-る + までもない
points.shortExplanation: It's not necessary to the extent of; no need to.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not necessary to the extent of".

points.title: ～には及ばない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + には及ばない
points.shortExplanation: Means 'no need to go that far' or 'not necessary'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "no need to go that far".

points.title: Noun にとどまらず～も
points.formation: Noun + にとどまらず + Noun + も
points.shortExplanation: This expresses the idea of 'not only...but also', 'not stopping at...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not stopping at X, also Y".

points.title: Noun もさることながら Noun も
points.romaji: A mo saru koto nagara B mo
points.formation: Noun1 + もさることながら + Noun2 + も
points.shortExplanation: Means 'not only... but also'; the second noun is especially emphasized.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not only... but especially" - emphasizes the second item as more notable.

points.title: Verbる にとどまらず～も
points.formation: Noun / Verb-dictionary form + にとどまらず + も/ほかのこと
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not only… but also', 'not limited to…'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not stopping at X, also Y". (Verb-attached form of n1-061.)

points.title: Noun に限ったことではない
points.formation: Noun + に限ったことではない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is not only limited to; 'not only', 'not just'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not only limited to...".

points.title: Noun に限ったことでもない
points.formation: Noun + に限ったことでもない
points.shortExplanation: 'Not limited to'; 'not just', 'not exclusively'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not only limited to...". (でも variant of n1-069's ではない.)

points.title: Noun かたがた
points.formation: Noun + かたがた
points.shortExplanation: Do one thing while also doing another; 'while', 'and at the same time'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "while also doing/for the purpose of" - similar function to がてら, more formal register.
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: Noun がてら
points.formation: Noun + がてら
points.shortExplanation: Means 'while...at the same time', 'on the occasion of', or 'along with'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "while...at the same time" - doing a second thing incidentally during the first.
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: Verb がてら
points.formation: Verb (dictionary or -ます stem) + がてら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses doing something while doing another; 'while', 'on the occasion of'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "while...at the same time". (Verb-attached form of n1-017's Noun がてら.)
points.familyName: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
points.chapterTitle: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)

points.title: Verbる べく
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べく
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the meaning of 'in order to', 'for the purpose of'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "in order to"; written language, formal speeches.

points.title: ～んがために
points.formation: Verb-negative stem + んがために
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes the reason or purpose for an action; 'in order to', 'for the sake of'.
points.usageNote: Very formal, emphatic literary "for the sake of/in order to"; found in formal writing, rare in speech.

points.title: A うと B うと
points.formation: い-adjective (-かろう) + と, な-adjective / Noun + であろうと
points.shortExplanation: Shows that the speaker is indifferent to both conditions; 'whether A or B'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A かれ B かれ
points.formation: Commonly i-adjective stems + かれ + i-adjective stems + かれ (e.g. 早かれ遅かれ). Also sometimes Noun + かれ + Noun + かれ in older usage.
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whether A or B'; both situations are included.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A であれ B であれ
points.formation: Noun A + であれ + Noun B + であれ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates the same statement applies to both A and B; 'whether A or B'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A とも B とも
points.formation: Noun + とも + Noun + とも (or sometimes Verb forms for each A, B)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses two possibilities; 'either A or B', 'whether A or B'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A にしろ B にしろ
points.formation: Noun A + にしろ + Noun B + にしろ, or Verb-casual A + にしろ + Verb-casual B + にしろ
points.shortExplanation: Means 'whether it is A or B'; 'regardless of A or B'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A にせよ B にせよ
points.romaji: A ni seyo B ni seyo
points.formation: Noun + にせよ + Noun + にせよ (also works with verbs in dictionary form + にせよ)
points.shortExplanation: Either A or B; Regardless of whether it's A or B.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: A につけ B につけ
points.romaji: A ni tsuke B ni tsuke
points.formation: Phrase A (dictionary/adjective form) + につけ、Phrase B (dictionary/adjective form) + につけ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whether... or...', 'both... and...', 'in either case'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: Noun といい Noun といい
points.formation: Noun1 + といい + Noun2 + といい + Comment
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'both A and B'; 'whether it's A or B'; 'not to mention A and also B'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: Noun といわず Noun といわず
points.romaji: A to iwazu B to iwazu
points.formation: Noun1 + といわず + Noun2 + といわず + (rest of the sentence)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'both A and B' or 'be it A or B'; applies to both without distinction.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - one of several near-interchangeable "whether A or B" constructions; stylistic choice more than a formality ladder.

points.title: Noun なり Noun なり
points.formation: Noun + なり + Noun + なり
points.shortExplanation: Lists alternatives of the same kind; 'either A or B', 'A or B, for example'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "either A or B, for example" - lists representative alternatives of the same kind.

points.title: Noun によらず
points.formation: Noun + によらず
points.shortExplanation: Regardless of, irrespective of.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of/irrespective of".

points.title: Noun のいかんにかかわらず
points.formation: Noun + のいかんにかかわらず
points.shortExplanation: Regardless of, irrespective of.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of/irrespective of" - a noun-suffix variant using のいかん.

points.title: Noun のいかんによらず
points.formation: Noun + のいかんによらず
points.shortExplanation: Means 'regardless of', 'irrespective of', or 'no matter'
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of/irrespective of".

points.title: Noun + はどうであれ
points.formation: Noun + はどうであれ
points.shortExplanation: This phrase means 'regardless of' or 'no matter how…'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of/no matter how".

points.title: ～だろうとなかろうと
points.formation: Noun / i-Adjective / na-Adjective / Verb + だろうとなかろうと
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'regardless of whether it is or isn't'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "regardless of whether it is or isn't".

points.title: どんなに～うが
points.formation: どんなに + Verb-volitional + うが, どんなに + い-Adjective(～かろう) + が, どんなに + な-Adjective + だろうが
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'no matter how much...', 'even if...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "no matter how much..." - emphasizes degree specifically.

points.title: Noun ずくめ
points.formation: Noun + ずくめ
points.shortExplanation: Denotes 'entirely' or 'nothing but' the preceding noun.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "entirely covered in/nothing but X" - describes a state entirely characterized by one quality (e.g. dressed all in black).

points.title: Noun に限る
points.formation: Noun + に限る
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that 'nothing but', 'nothing is better than'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "nothing beats X/best to do X" - a recommendation, not a plain restriction.

points.title: Verb ようか Verbるまいか
points.romaji: Verb you ka Verb ru mai ka
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + か + Verb-volitional negative form (まい) + か
points.shortExplanation: Expresses indecision: 'Should I do it or not?'.
points.usageNote: "Should I do X or not" - expresses indecision about a single action.

points.title: Verb ようが Verb るまいが
points.romaji: Verb you ga Verb ru mai ga
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + が + Verb-negative volitional form + が
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'whether or not', 'no matter if something happens or not'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "whether one does X or not, (the outcome is unchanged)" - stronger, more declarative than ようか～まいか.

points.title: ～とされる
points.formation: Verb-casual + とされる / い-Adjective + とされる / な-Adjective + だとされる / Noun + だとされる
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a general belief or widely accepted view; 'is considered', 'is seen as', 'is said to be'.
points.usageNote: Formal "is considered/is said to be" - reports a general, often official, view.

points.title: ～とみられる
points.formation: Verb-casual + とみられる, Noun + とみられる
points.shortExplanation: It is considered that; It is thought that; It is believed that
points.usageNote: Formal "is regarded as/is seen as" - similar formal reporting register to とされる.

points.title: Noun なくして～はない
points.formation: Noun + なくして + Sentence ～はない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'without ~, there can't be ~'; 'can't do ~ without first doing ~'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "without X, there can be no Y" - abstract/conceptual necessity.

points.title: Noun なしでは～ない
points.formation: Noun + なしでは～ない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the necessity of something; 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.
points.usageNote: "Cannot do without X" - practical necessity.

points.title: A うが B うが
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + うが + Verb-volitional form + うが, or Adjective (-かろう) + が + Adjective (-かろう) + が
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'no matter how... or', 'even if... or'.

points.title: A かたわら B
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + かたわら, Noun + のかたわら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'while also', 'at the same time as'.

points.title: A だの B だの
points.formation: Noun/Verb casual + だの + Noun/Verb casual + だの
points.shortExplanation: Used to list examples (often with a critical or complaining tone); 'things like A, B, etc.'.

points.title: A というか B というか
points.romaji: A to iu ka B to iu ka
points.formation: Phrase A + というか + Phrase B + というか
points.shortExplanation: Means 'rather than say A, it's more like B', or 'whether to call it A or B'.

points.title: A のやら B のやら
points.romaji: A no yara B no yara
points.formation: Noun1 + のやら + Noun2 + のやら (also works with adjectives and verbs + のやら)
points.shortExplanation: Used when the speaker is unsure or confused between multiple possibilities.

points.title: Noun1 が Noun1 なら、 Noun2 も Noun2 だ
points.romaji: A ga A nara, B mo B da
points.formation: Noun1 + が + (repeat Noun1) + なら、Noun2 + も + (repeat Noun2) + だ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a parallel or matching situation; 'if Noun1 is (truly) Noun1, then Noun2 is also Noun2'.

points.title: Noun1 も Noun1 なら、Noun2 も Noun2 だ
points.romaji: A mo A nara, B mo B da
points.formation: Noun1 + も + (repeat Noun1) + なら、Noun2 + も + (repeat Noun2) + だ
points.shortExplanation: Highlights two parallel facts or characteristics; 'if it’s said that ~, then it can also be said that ~'.

points.title: Noun + あっての + Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + あっての + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'B cannot exist without A'; 'B only exists because of A'.

points.title: Noun からある
points.formation: Number + Counter + からある
points.shortExplanation: Used with large numbers or measurements to emphasize 'at least that many' or 'no less than.'

points.title: Noun からする
points.formation: Noun + からする
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate that something is judged, estimated, or considered from a certain point or aspect.

points.title: Noun からの
points.formation: Noun + からの
points.shortExplanation: Defines the starting point or the origin; 'from'.

points.title: Noun から言わせれば
points.formation: Noun + から言わせれば
points.shortExplanation: Express the perspective of the noun; 'from ~'s point of view.'

points.title: Noun + ぐるみ
points.formation: Noun + ぐるみ
points.shortExplanation: Describes 'entirely', 'all together', or 'as a whole group'.

points.title: Noun こそあれ
points.formation: Noun + こそあれ + (result/continuation)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'though there is ... (some negative or burdensome aspect), still ...'.

points.title: Noun こそ～が
points.formation: Noun + こそ + (statement) + が + (contrasting/additional statement)
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes that 'it is precisely Noun that ...', then adds a contrasting or additional point.

points.title: Noun こそすれ
points.formation: Noun + こそすれ + (negative or contrasting statement)
points.shortExplanation: An emphatic pattern meaning 'it may be X, but definitely not Y.' Often pairs with a negative statement.

points.title: Noun ごとき / Noun ごとく
points.formation: Noun + ごとき, Noun + ごとく, Verb-casual + ごとく, い-Adjective + ごとく
points.shortExplanation: Means 'like a...', 'as if...', expressing a simile or metaphor.

points.title: Noun じゃあるまいし
points.formation: Noun or Na-Adjective + じゃあるまいし
points.shortExplanation: Expressing that something 'is not'; 'it's not like...'. Colloquial/masculine form of ではあるまいし.

points.title: Noun だけではすまない
points.formation: Noun + だけではすまない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'it can't be settled with just...', 'cannot be resolved merely by...'.

points.title: Noun たる Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + たる + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'being in the position/state of', used for roles or statuses.

points.title: Noun でなくてなんだろう
points.formation: Noun + でなくてなんだろう
points.shortExplanation: A strong rhetorical question: 'If not X, then what is it?'

points.title: Noun ではあるまいし
points.formation: Noun + ではあるまいし
points.shortExplanation: Means 'it’s not as if...', 'it’s not that...', more formal than じゃあるまいし.

points.title: Noun と Noun を兼ねて
points.formation: Noun + と + Noun + を兼ねて
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate doing two things at once or fulfilling two roles/purposes.

points.title: Noun という Noun
points.formation: Noun1 という Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Used to specify or define one noun with another; 'the noun called', 'the noun that is', or 'a certain'.

points.title: Noun というところだ
points.formation: Noun + というところだ
points.shortExplanation: Means 'it's approximately...' or 'it's about...'. Used to show approximation or a general assessment.

points.title: Noun + というもの
points.formation: Noun + というもの
points.shortExplanation: Used to express a generic concept: 'all ~', 'any ~ of that kind'.

points.title: Noun といったところだ
points.formation: Noun + といったところだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'at most', 'as much as', or 'limited to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "at most, roughly..." - a modest, understating assessment.

points.title: Noun + ときたら
points.formation: Noun + ときたら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses strong feelings about a topic; 'speaking of', 'when it comes to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary, often exasperated - "when it comes to X (with strong feelings)".

points.title: Noun とは比べものにならない
points.formation: Noun + とは比べものにならない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates something is not comparable; 'beyond comparison'.

points.title: Noun + ともあろう + Noun
points.formation: Noun + ともあろう + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to criticize or question unbecoming behavior by someone of a certain status.

points.title: Noun ともなると
points.formation: Noun + ともなると
points.shortExplanation: 'When it comes to...', emphasizes a change of situation or status.

points.title: Noun と相まって
points.formation: Noun + と相まって
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'in combination with', 'together with', 'along with'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "in combination with" - typically for multiple factors compounding together.

points.title: Noun ならいざ知らず
points.formation: Noun1 + ならいざ知らず + Noun2 (comment)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'maybe X is possible, but Y is definitely not'. Often 'let alone...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "X is one thing, but Y is another (less certain) matter".

points.title: Noun + ならでは
points.formation: Noun + ならでは
points.shortExplanation: Expresses something unique or characteristic only of that noun; 'only found in', 'only possible with'.

points.title: Noun なりとも
points.formation: Noun + なりとも
points.shortExplanation: Indicates even a small amount or degree; 'at least', 'even a little'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "at least/even a little" - emphasizes a minimal but real amount.

points.title: Noun に Noun を重ねて
points.formation: Noun に Noun を重ねて
points.shortExplanation: This expression is used to describe repeated actions or states, 'one after another' or 'pile up'.

points.title: Noun にあっては
points.formation: Noun + にあっては
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a specific situation or environment in which something happens or is the case.

points.title: Noun にあるまじき Noun
points.formation: Noun1 にあるまじき Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'unfitting', 'unbecoming' or 'inappropriate'.

points.title: Noun にして初めて
points.formation: Noun + にして初めて
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'only when/after... for the first time'.

points.title: Noun にひきかえ Noun は
points.formation: Noun 1 + にひきかえ + Noun 2 + は
points.shortExplanation: Represents 'in contrast to', 'as opposed to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "in contrast to" - a deliberate, pointed contrast; written register.

points.title: Noun に先駆けて
points.formation: Noun + に先駆けて
points.shortExplanation: Meaning 'ahead of', 'before', or 'preceding in time'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "ahead of/in advance of" - announcements, official events.

points.title: Noun に言わせれば
points.formation: Noun + に言わせれば
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'according to', 'if you ask', 'in the opinion of'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "according to/if you ask..." - introduces a strong personal opinion.

points.title: Noun ぬいた Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + をぬいた + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'taking something out from something else'.

points.title: Noun + ぬいて
points.formation: Noun + ぬいて
points.shortExplanation: This is a way to express 'minus' or 'except for' some specific noun.

points.title: ～ぬく
points.formation: Verb-stem + ぬく
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of doing something completely or thoroughly.

points.title: Noun+のいかんだ
points.formation: Noun + のいかんだ/Noun + のいかんでは
points.shortExplanation: Depends on; up to

points.title: Noun のいかんでは
points.formation: Noun + のいかんでは
points.shortExplanation: It depends on the Noun

points.title: Noun のいかんによっては
points.romaji: Noun no ikan ni yotte wa
points.formation: Noun + のいかんによっては
points.shortExplanation: Depending on the matter; depending on noun

points.title: Noun のごとき Noun
points.formation: Noun1 + のごとき + Noun2
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'like' or 'as if'; something/someone resembles something else strongly.
points.usageNote: Very formal, literary "like/as if" - echoes classical Japanese; rare outside formal writing.

points.title: Noun のことだから
points.formation: Noun + のことだから
points.shortExplanation: Because it is about ~, considering it's ~

points.title: Noun の 嫌いがある
points.formation: Noun + の嫌いがある
points.shortExplanation: Have a dislike for a particular Noun

points.title: Noun の手前
points.formation: Noun + の手前
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'Before doing something; on the verge of'.

points.title: Noun の極み
points.formation: Noun + の極み
points.shortExplanation: Used to express the extreme or utmost point of something.

points.title: Noun の 至り
points.formation: Noun + の至り
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the height of', 'the extreme of' something.

points.title: Noun はおろか～すら
points.formation: Noun1 はおろか, Noun2 すら/さえ ～
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not to mention ~, even ~'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "not to mention X, even Y" - emphasizes Y as more extreme than the already-notable X.

points.title: Noun はさておき
points.formation: Noun + はさておき
points.shortExplanation: Means 'putting aside', 'aside from', 'notwithstanding'.

points.title: Noun まみれ
points.formation: Noun + まみれ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a state in which something is entirely covered or filled with something else.

points.title: Noun も兼ねて
points.formation: Noun + も兼ねて
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'as well as', 'also', or 'at the same time'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "doubling as/also serving as" - describes one action serving two purposes.

points.title: Noun も相まって
points.formation: Noun + も相まって
points.shortExplanation: Used to express that combined with something else, it caused a certain outcome.

points.title: Noun を おいて他に Verb ない
points.formation: Noun + をおいて他に + Verb negative form
points.shortExplanation: Means 'apart from ~ there's nothing else,' implying the Noun is the best or most suitable choice.

points.title: Noun をものともせずに
points.romaji: Noun wo mono tomo sezu ni
points.formation: Noun + をものともせずに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that 'despite something, action was carried out', translating to 'without being fazed by something'.

points.title: Noun をよそに
points.formation: Noun + をよそに
points.shortExplanation: Despite; Notwithstanding; Regardless of

points.title: Noun を余儀なくされる
points.formation: Noun + を + 余儀なくされる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of being forced into a certain situation, 'to be compelled', 'to be obliged'.

points.title: Noun を前提にして
