points.formation: Noun + を前提にして
points.shortExplanation: Assuming; presupposing; on the assumption of.

points.title: Noun を境にして
points.formation: Noun + を境に(して)
points.shortExplanation: Means 'as a turning point', 'since (time)', or 'from (time) on'.

points.title: Noun を機にして
points.formation: Noun + を機にして
points.shortExplanation: To take the opportunity to; taking the occasion to; on the occasion of.

points.title: Noun を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
points.romaji: Noun wo kawakiri ni / wo kawakiri ni shite
points.formation: Noun + を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate the starting point of some series of events or actions; 'starting with', 'beginning with'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "starting with" - marks the first in an impressive/escalating series.

points.title: Noun を経て
points.formation: Noun + を経て
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'through' or 'via'; going through some process or phase.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "via/through (a process or stage)" - describes a path or progression.

points.title: Noun を踏まえて
points.formation: Noun + を踏まえて
points.shortExplanation: Based on; taking into account; in light of

points.title: Noun 並み
points.formation: Noun + 並み
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'like' or 'as' something or someone; 'equivalent to', 'around'.

points.title: Noun + 前提で
points.formation: Noun + 前提で
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a condition or requirement for something to be established: 'on the assumption that', 'under the condition of'.

points.title: Verbる / Noun(である) + 限り(は)
points.formation:
Verb-dictionary form + 限り(は)
Noun(である) + 限り(は)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as long as', 'while this condition is true'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "as long as (this condition holds)".

points.title: Verb こそすれ
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + こそすれ、(絶対に)～ない
points.shortExplanation: Often used in the pattern 'Xこそすれ、Y〜ない', meaning 'One might do X, but definitely not Y'.

points.title: Verb させられる
points.formation: Verb-casual (non-past) + させられる
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'being forced to do something' or 'being made to do something'.

points.title: Verb ずじまい
points.formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない) + ずじまい
points.shortExplanation: Expressing regret for not having done something; not being able to; missing the chance to do it.

points.title: Verb ずとも
points.formation: Verb-negative stem + ずとも
points.shortExplanation: Means 'Even without doing (X), (Y) can still happen'.

points.title: Verb そばから
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + そばから
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that as soon as one action finishes, another begins immediately.

points.title: Verb たことにしてください
points.formation: Verb (past, casual) + ことにしてください
points.shortExplanation: Asking someone to pretend or accept that something has already happened or taken a certain state.

points.title: Verb たら Verb たで
points.formation: Verb-た form + ら + (same Verb-た form) + で
points.shortExplanation: Conveys that if something happens (or doesn’t happen), there is a particular consequence or situation either way.

points.title: Verb たら きりがない
points.formation: Verb-た form + ら + きりがない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an endless or unending cycle once an action is started; 'if one starts doing something, it will not stop.'

points.title: Verb つ Verb つ
points.formation: Verb-ますstem + つ + Verb-ますstem + つ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses two alternating actions happening repeatedly.

points.title: Verb てからというもの
points.romaji: Verb te kara to iu mono
points.formation: Verb-て form + からというもの
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that ever since a certain event happened, a condition has continued until now.

points.title: Verb てこそ
points.formation: Verb-て form + こそ
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes 'only by doing something, a certain result or realization can occur.'

points.title: Verb ては
points.formation: Verb-て form + は
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a repeated pattern or cycle, often implying a frustrating outcome; 'whenever X happens, Y happens again.'

points.title: Verb ては Verb
points.formation: Verb-て form + は + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a repeated pattern of action; translates as 'every time', 'whenever', etc.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "every time X, Y happens" - a repetitive pattern, often with a negative connotation.

points.title: Verb てまでも
points.formation: Verb-て form + までも
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'even if it means doing...', 'no matter what it takes'.

points.title: Verb てみせる
points.formation: Verb-て form + みせる
points.shortExplanation: 'Show by doing', 'demonstrate', 'prove by action'.

points.title: Verb ないものだろうか
points.formation: Verb-negative (often negative potential) + ものだろうか
points.shortExplanation: Expressing hope or wonder if something can be done: 'Isn't there a way...?', 'Can't we...?'

points.title: Verb ないものでもない
points.formation: Verb-negative form (ない form) + ものでもない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea that it's not entirely impossible or non-existent: 'It's not that I don't...', 'It's not that there aren't...'

points.title: Verb の ない Noun
points.formation: Verb in negative form + の + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to modify a noun with a negative verb form; 'a Noun without (Verb)'.

points.title: Verb ば きりがない
points.formation: Verb-conditional form (ば) + きりがない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates there's no end once you start listing, doing, or saying something: 'If one starts to..., there will be no end.'

points.title: Verb もしないで
points.formation: Verb (masu stem) + もしないで
points.shortExplanation: Means 'without even doing'.

points.title: Verb やしない
points.formation: Verb (masu stem) + やしない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a strong denial or refusal: 'I would never...', 'No way I would...'.

points.title: Verb よう
points.formation: Verb (dictionary or negative form) + ように (する / etc.)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'the way/manner of doing something' or 'in order to / so that / try to'.

points.title: Verb ようにも
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + にも + (reason/potential negative, etc.)
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'even though one wants to do something, one can't for some reason'.

points.title: Verb ようにも Verb れない
points.formation: Verb-volitional form + にも + (potential negative form / reason)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the inability to do something even if one wants/tries.

points.title: Verbる がままに
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + がままに
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'letting something happen as it is'; 'just as something does'.

points.title: Verbる が早いか
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + が早いか
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'as soon as...' or 'the moment when...'.

points.title: Verbる くらいなら
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + くらいなら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses preference to avoid something: 'rather than...', 'if it comes to doing X, I'd rather...'.

points.title: Verbる こと なし に
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことなしに
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'without doing something'.

points.title: Verbる ことのないように
points.romaji: Verb-ru koto no nai you ni
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことのないように
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the desire or effort to prevent something: 'so as not to...', 'to avoid...'.

points.title: Verbる ときりがない
points.formation: Verb-casual + と + きりがない
points.shortExplanation: Used to indicate that something can go on endlessly or without limits.

points.title: Verbる ともなく Verb
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ともなく + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'without a particular intention', 'unconsciously', or 'before one knows it'.

points.title: Verbる ともなしに Verb
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ともなしに + Verb
points.shortExplanation: Expresses doing something unintentionally or without conscious thought.

points.title: Verbる にも
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + にも + (reason it can't be done)
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that doing the verb is impossible or difficult, even if one wants to.

points.title: Verbる にも Verb れない
points.formation: Verb-volitional + にも + Verb-potential negative
points.shortExplanation: Expresses: 'Even if I try/want to do something, I cannot.'

points.title: Verbる べからざる Noun
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べからざる + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Used to express what should not be done; 'must not', 'should not'.
points.usageNote: Archaic, literary; found in formal notices, mottos, or written rules - rare in modern speech.

points.title: Verbる べからず
points.formation: Verb-ru + べからず
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'must not do' or 'should not do'.

points.title: Verbる べくもない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + べくもない
points.shortExplanation: Means 'it's impossible to...' or 'there's no way to...'.

points.title: Verbる ものとする
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものとする
points.shortExplanation: Assuming or deciding something as...

points.title: Verbる 始末だ
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 始末だ
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a (often unfortunate) result or conclusion of an action.

points.title: Verbる 嫌いがある
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + 嫌いがある
points.shortExplanation: Tendency to do a negative action; have a bad habit of ~.

points.title: いつまで～のやら
points.formation: いつまで + Verb (dictionary form) + のやら
points.shortExplanation: Expresses uncertainty regarding duration; 'don't know when... will end'.

points.title: ～が Verb られる
points.formation:
❶ (Group 1) Verb:  書く → 書ける / 飲む → 飲める, etc.
❷ (Group 2) Verb-ます stem + られる (食べる→食べられる、見る→見られる)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses potential or ability to do something; 'can', 'able to'.
points.usageNote: Literary potential form - directly conjugates the verb rather than using ことができる; more natural in writing.

points.title: ～かと思いきや
points.formation: Sentence + かと思いきや (Verb plain form, i-/na-Adjective, or Noun + だ + かと思いきや)
points.shortExplanation: Expressing unexpected outcomes; 'just when I thought...', 'but...'.

points.title: ～から Noun に 至る まで
points.formation: Noun (start) + から + Noun (end) + に至るまで
points.shortExplanation: Expressing range from one thing to another; 'from...to', 'ranging from...to'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "ranging all the way from X to Y" - emphasizes the full extent.

points.title: ～ごとく
points.formation: Verb-て + ごとく / Noun + の + ごとく
points.shortExplanation: To seem like; as if; as though.

points.title: ～ずにすんだ
points.formation: Verb-ず form + に + すんだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'was able to do without'; 'managed to avoid'.

points.title: ～ではすまない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + ではすまない / い-Adjective + ではすまない / な-Adjective + ではすまない / Noun + ではすまない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that just doing something is not enough or will not suffice.

points.title: ～とあって
points.formation: Noun + とあって / (Sometimes Verb + とあって, depending on context)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a special situation or event due to certain circumstances.

points.title: ～といったらありゃしない
points.formation: Verb-casual + といったらありゃしない / い-Adjective + といったらありゃしない / な-Adjective + だ + といったらありゃしない / Noun + だ + といったらありゃしない
points.shortExplanation: Emphasizes that something is to the extreme; 'you have no idea how...', 'it's incredibly...'.

points.title: ～といったらない
points.formation: い-Adjective + といったらない / な-Adjective + だといったらない / Noun + だといったらない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the extreme of something; 'nothing can be more ... than this'.

points.title: ～ときている
points.formation: Verb-casual / い-Adjective / な-Adjective（＋だ） / Noun（＋だ） + ときている
points.shortExplanation: Highlights a situation or condition that is serious/extreme, often with a negative nuance.

points.title: ～ところを
points.formation: Verb-ている + ところを / Noun + の + ところを / い-Adjective + ところを / な-Adjective + な + ところを
points.shortExplanation: Indicates a contrasting or inconvenient timing; 'just when...', 'even though...'.

points.title: ～とすれば
points.formation: Verb-casual + とすれば / い-Adjective + とすれば / な-Adjective + だとすれば / Noun + だとすれば
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'if it were the case that...', 'if we assume that...'.

points.title: ～となったら
points.formation: Verb-casual + となったら / Noun + となったら
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'if it comes to...', 'when it becomes the case that...'.

points.title: ～となると
points.formation: Verb-casual + となると / い-Adjective + となると / な-Adjective + だとなると / Noun + だとなると
points.shortExplanation: Used to highlight a certain circumstance; 'when it comes to...', 'if it becomes...', 'in the event that...'.

points.title: ～となれば
points.formation: Verb-casual + となれば, い-Adjective + となれば, な-Adjective + だとなれば, Noun + だとなれば
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea of 'if it comes to...; when we talk about...; in the case of...'.

points.title: ～とみると
points.formation: Verb-casual + とみると, い-Adjective + とみると, な-Adjective + だとみると, Noun + だとみると
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'when one sees it as', 'viewed as', or 'considering'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "viewed as/considering".

points.title: ～と言わんばかりに
points.formation: Verb-volitional + と言わんばかりに, い-Adjective + と言わんばかりに, な-Adjective + だと言わんばかりに, Noun + だと言わんばかりに
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an action or behavior that strongly implies a certain unspoken message or feeling.

points.title: ～と言わんばかりの Noun
points.formation: Verb-plain form + と言わんばかりの Noun
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the concept of 'as if to say'; 'almost says'; 'suggests'.

points.title: ～ながらに
points.formation: Common set phrases: 生まれながらに, 涙ながらに, 昔ながらに, 子供ながらに, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a state or condition continuing just as it is (e.g. 'from birth', 'while crying', 'in the old way').

points.title: ～ながらの Noun
points.formation: Verb-ますstem (or plain minus る) + ながら + の + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Indicates one action or state happening at the same time as the noun in question (e.g. 'dinner while watching TV').

points.title: ～なくはない
points.formation: Verb-ないform + なくはない, い-Adjective－い + くはない, な-Adjective + ではなくはない, Noun + ではなくはない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the idea 'it's not that it's impossible' or 'it's not that I can't'.
points.usageNote: "It's not that it's impossible" - a hedged, soft admission.

points.title: ～なら～なりに
points.formation: Noun/Adjective + なら + (same Noun/Adjective) + なりに
points.shortExplanation: Means 'if it is X, then it's X in its own way', emphasizing unique qualities.

points.title: ～に堪えない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪えない, Noun + に堪えない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates something is unbearable or not worth doing (e.g., 'unbearable to watch', 'unbearable to listen to').

points.title: ～に堪える
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪える, Noun + に堪える
points.shortExplanation: Used to say that something is 'worth doing' or 'can stand up to' something (the positive counterpart of ～に堪えない).

points.title: ～に耐える
points.formation: Noun + に耐える
points.shortExplanation: To endure or withstand something; 'endure', 'withstand', 'tolerate'.

points.title: ～に至った
points.formation: Verb-てform + に至った or Noun / Verb-dictionary + に至る (more general).
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the outcome or final conclusion of a process; 'reached the point', 'led to'.

points.title: ～に越したことはない
points.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + に越したことはない, い-Adjective + に越したことはない, な-Adjective/Noun + である + に越したことはない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something is the best or most desirable course of action; 'nothing better than...'.

points.title: ～に難くない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + に難くない (commonly with 想像する, 理解する, 察する, etc.)
points.shortExplanation: Expresses 'not difficult to ~' in a formal/literary sense; e.g., 'not hard to imagine/understand'.

points.title: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ
points.romaji: 〜no wa Noun gurai no mono da
points.formation: Verb-casual + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, い-Adjective + のは + Noun + ぐらいのものだ, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Conveys that 'only (Noun) is the case' or 'nothing but (Noun)'.

points.title: ～ば～ものを
points.formation: Verb-ば + Verb-past + ものを, い-Adjective + ければ + ものを, な-Adjective/Noun + であれば + ものを, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Expresses regret or a missed opportunity: 'if only', 'had I but...'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary - expresses regret with a hint of reproach; "if only... (but you didn't)".

points.title: ～びた
points.formation: [Noun/Adjective stem] + びた (forms a 連体形 modifier, e.g., 大人びた人 “an adult-like person”)
points.shortExplanation: A suffix meaning “looking or seeming like ~” (often appears with nouns/adjectives).

points.title: ～びる
points.formation: Adjective/Noun + びる (to form a verb)
points.shortExplanation: A suffix meaning “to appear/to become ~,” often used with certain adjectives or nouns.

points.title: ～ぶった
points.formation: Noun/Adjective + ぶる → ぶった (past tense), e.g., 偉そうぶった, 大人ぶった
points.shortExplanation: Often appears as a past form of ～ぶる, meaning 'acted/pretended like ~' (or literally 'hit/bashed', depending on context).

points.title: ～ぶって
points.formation: Noun/Adjective + ぶる → ぶって (te-form)
points.shortExplanation: Te-form of ～ぶる, meaning 'acting/pretending to be ~'.

points.title: ～ぶり
points.formation: Time expression + ぶり
points.shortExplanation: Expresses the amount of time elapsed since doing something last.

points.title: ～ぶる
points.formation: Noun / (Adjective stem) + ぶる
points.shortExplanation: Used when someone is acting or pretending to be something they are not (often a negative connotation).

points.title: ～までだ
points.formation: Verb (dictionary/ない form) + までだ, い-Adjective + までだ, Noun + までだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses a limit or extent; 'it's only up to...', 'no more than...'.

points.title: ～もなんでもない
points.formation: Verb-dictionary form + もなんでもない, い-Adjective + もなんでもない, な-Adjective + なもなんでもない, Noun + もなんでもない
points.shortExplanation: Used to dismiss or negate something’s importance; 'it’s nothing at all', 'it doesn’t matter'.

points.title: ～ものとして
points.formation: Verb-casual + ものとして, い-Adjective + ものとして, な-Adjective + なものとして, Noun + のものとして
points.shortExplanation: Indicates an assumption or supposition; 'assuming', 'under the assumption that'.
points.usageNote: Formal, literary "under the assumption that" - written, formal planning/argument contexts.

points.title: ～んばかりに
points.formation: Verb-negative stem + ん + ばかりに
points.shortExplanation: Indicates 'as though about to ~' or 'as if to say ~'.

points.title: ～差し支えない
points.formation: Verb-て form + も差し支えない, Noun + が差し支えない
points.shortExplanation: Indicates no problem or obstacle; 'it’s fine if...', 'there’s no issue'.

points.title: ～極まる
points.formation: な-Adjective（語幹）+ 極まる, い-Adjective（連用形）+ こと + 極まる, etc.
points.shortExplanation: Also expresses an extreme degree or state, typically negative.

points.title: ～足りない
points.formation: Noun + (が) 足りない, Verb-casual + ほど/だけ + (が) 足りない
points.shortExplanation: Expresses insufficiency or lack; 'not enough', 'insufficient'.

points.title: ～足る Noun
points.formation: Noun/Verb-dictionary form + に足る + Noun
points.shortExplanation: Indicates that something is worthy or sufficient to be called/used as ~; 'worthy of', 'enough to ~'.

points.title: ～限りだ
points.formation: い-Adjective + 限りだ, な-Adjective + な/である + 限りだ, Noun + の + 限りだ
points.shortExplanation: Expresses an extreme degree of emotion or reaction; 'I feel so ~', 'as ~ as can be'.

points.title: ですから～
points.formation: Sentence A + ですから + Sentence B
points.shortExplanation: Expresses reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'so'.
points.usageNote: Polite form of だから; safe in formal/polite conversation.

points.title: あまり～ないです
points.formation: あまり + Verb-ないform + です / あまり + い-Adjective-くない + です / あまり + な-Adjective-じゃない + です
points.shortExplanation: Express 'not really' or 'not very'; used to soften a negative statement.

points.title: だれも～ないです
points.formation: だれも + Verb-negative form (ないです), だれも + い-Adjective-negative form (ないです), だれも + な-Adjective-negative form (じゃないです)
points.shortExplanation: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in a negative sentence.

points.title: どこにも + Verb + ないです
points.romaji: doko ni mo + Verb + nai desu
points.formation: どこにも + Verb in ない-form + です
points.shortExplanation: Express that an action cannot be performed anywhere or something cannot be found anywhere.
points.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこへも variant of n5-105's どこにも.)

points.title: どこへも Verb ないです
points.romaji: doko e mo + Verb + nai desu
points.formation: どこへも + Verb in negative form (ないです)
points.shortExplanation: Express that an action doesn't take place anywhere; 'nowhere', 'not anywhere'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more conversational variant, ないです instead of ません. (どこへも variant.)

points.title: どこへも Verb ません
points.formation: どこへも + Verb-negative
points.shortExplanation: Nowhere; Not to any place
points.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこへも variant, ません form.)

points.title: どこも Verb ないです
points.formation: どこも + Verb-negative
points.shortExplanation: Express that something cannot be found anywhere or in any place; 'nowhere', 'in no place'.
points.usageNote: Slightly more conversational variant, ないです instead of ません.

points.title: どこも Verb ません
points.formation: どこも + Verb-ます form + ません
points.shortExplanation: Express that 'nowhere' meets the verb action; 'nowhere does/can'.
points.usageNote: Standard polite negative - "not anywhere". (どこも variant of n5-105's どこにも - functionally identical.)

points.title: なにも～ないです
points.formation: なにも + Verb-negative
points.shortExplanation: Used to express 'not any' or 'nothing' in a negative sentence.

points.title: まだ〜ないです
points.formation: まだ + Verb-negative + です
points.shortExplanation: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet.
